statuses.name: Power Up
statuses.desc: Skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.desc: Skill 2 gains Final Power by the effect’s Count for this turn.

statuses.desc: Skill 1 gains Final Power by the effect’s Count for this turn.

statuses.name: Swordplay of the Homeland
statuses.desc:
- When at 5+ Poise, upon Skill use, Skill 1 and Skill 2 gain Coin Power +(3/# of Coins, minimum 1) and deal +(30/# of Coins)% damage on Critical Hit
- When at 7+ Poise, upon Skill use, Skill 3 deals +(30/# of Coins)% damage and deals +(50/# of Coins)% damage on Critical Hit

statuses.name: Aggro
statuses.desc: In focused encounters, slots with higher Aggro values are more likely to be targeted by enemies.

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc: When attacking, take fixed damage equal to (Count)% of current HP, then halve it.

statuses.name: Paralyze
statuses.desc: Fix the Power of Coins to 0 for one turn, with one Coin per the effect’s Count.

statuses.name: Poise
statuses.desc:
On hit, gain a Potency-based chance to deal critical damage, reducing the Count by 1 if successful.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Slash Power Up
statuses.desc: Slash skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

passives.descriptionEn: Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, gain 0 Entanglement and 0 String Severance -絕緣- Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, for every 3 The House of Spiders Identities in the Loadout (including this unit), raise Entanglement's Min & Max Stack cap by 1 (max 3) If any of The House of Spiders allied Identities are on the field, transfer HP damage taken to The House of Spiders Identity that has the lowest current HP percentage When this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, this unit's HP does not drop below 1 for the turn (once per Encounter) Apply the following effects based on The House of Spiders ally death: - Gain 1 Entanglement - For this Encounter, gain additional effects based on which of The House of Spiders allied Identity was defeated · The House of Spiders: The Index Nursefather Yi Sang: On Base Attack Skill Use, convert the final Coin into Unbreakable Coin. Deal +10% damage with Base Attack Skills' Unbreakable Coins · The Index Proxy - Effloresced E.G.O::Procuration Don Quixote: On Base Attack Skill Use, gain 2 Poise. On Crit using Base Attack Skills, inflict 1 Sinking · The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael: Defense Level +2. Inflict +1 more Burn Potency using Base Skills · The House of Spiders: The Ring Nursefather Hong Lu: Gain Somatic Frisson-inspiring Melody · The House of Spiders: The Ring Apprentice Faust: Gain Shield equal to 10% HP at every Turn Start · The House of Spiders: The Pinky Apprentice Sinclair: Gain +1 Poise Count and 1 Crit DMG Up at every Turn Start If there are no Identities left to Substitute or Return, Blade of the House of Spiders Ryōshū gains +1 Skill Slot for every 3 The House of Spiders allies that are defeated (max 3 times) - This effect cannot increase Skill Slots beyond the maximum Skill Slot cap of this Encounter - For certain game contents, this effect can activate regardless of the contents' Skill Slot increase restriction This Identity only counts as an "Identity that applies Burn, Bleed, and Poise" When conditions are met, change battle music for the rest of the Encounter (excluding certain Encounters)
passives.descriptionKo:
전투에 첫 등장 시, 얽힘 0, 절연[絕緣] 0 얻음.

전투에 첫 등장 시, 편성된 거미집 소속 아군 인격(자신 포함) 3명당 얽힘의 최솟값, 최댓값이 1 증가 (최대 3)

거미집 소속 인격이 출전중이면, 자신이 체력 피해를 받을 때 현재 체력 비율이 가장 낮은 거미집 소속 아군 인격에게 받은 체력 피해를 전가함

체력이 0이 되는 피해를 받을 때 해당 턴 동안 체력이 1 미만으로 감소하지 않음 (전투당 1회)

거미집 소속 아군 인격이 사망한 상태면, 아래 효과 적용
- 얽힘 1 얻음
- 사망한 인격에 따라 이번 전투 동안 아래 추가 효과를 얻음
 · 거미집 검지 아비 이상 : 기본 공격 스킬 사용시 마지막 코인이 파괴 불가 코인으로 변경됨. 기본 공격 스킬의 파괴 불가 코인의 피해량 +10%
 · 검지 대행자 - 개화 E.G.O:: 대행 돈키호테 : 기본 공격 스킬 사용시 호흡 2 얻음. 기본 공격 스킬 크리티컬 적중시 침잠 1 부여
 · 거미집 중지 제자 이스마엘 : 방어 레벨 +2, 기본 스킬로 부여하는 화상 위력 +1
 · 거미집 약지 아비 홍루 : 신체가 울리는 선율 얻음
 · 거미집 약지 제자 파우스트 : 매 턴 시작시 최대 체력의 10%만큼 보호막 얻음
 · 거미집 소지 제자 싱클레어 : 매 턴 시작시 호흡 횟수 1, 크리티컬 피해량 증가 1 얻음

대기 해제 또는 복귀할 인격이 없으면, 사망 상태인 아군 거미집 소속 인격 3명당 거미집의 검 료슈의 슬롯 수 +1 (최대 3회 증가)
- 이 효과로 인해 해당 전투의 최대 슬롯 수를 초과하여 슬롯이 증가할 수 없음
- 일부 콘텐츠의 슬롯 증가 제한 효과를 무시하고 발동 가능

이 인격은 화상, 출혈, 호흡을 부여하는 인격으로만 취급됨

특정 조건 달성 시 이번 전투 동안 전투 BGM을 변경 (일부 전투 제외)

statuses.desc:
- Unique Sinking
- Base Value: 0, Max Value: 15
- The Potency and the Count of this effect are called "The Living" and "The Departed", respectively.
- When hit, the attacker heals (The Living/4) SP. (min 1; rounded down)
- When hit, and if this unit's SP is at less than 0, take (Sinking Potency/5) Gloom damage for every value of The Departed. (max Gloom damage 30; rounded down; deals half damage to targets that are Non-SP Units.)
- Turn End: Reset The Departed of this effect to 0; then, gain Sinking equal to The Living and convert The Living into The Departed.
- No external effects can raise the amount of Butterfly inflicted. "Inflict additional Sinking" effects inflict additional Sinking instead of additional Butterfly.
- This effect expires when both The Living and The Departed reach 0.

ldPassives.nameEn: The Fixer at the Crack of Dawn
ldPassives.descriptionKo:
스테이지 첫 등장 시 새벽불 0 얻음

화상 피해로 흐트러짐 상태가 되거나 체력이 1 미만으로 감소하지 않음
화상 효과로 받는 피해량 -50%
- 체력이 50% 미만이면 효과가 강화되어, 화상 효과로 받는 피해량 -75%
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, gain 0 Light of Daybreak Cannot be Staggered or fall below 1 HP due to Burn damage Take -50% damage from Burn effects (rounded down) - At less than 50% HP, take -75% damage from Burn effects instead (rounded down)

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
스테이지 첫 등장 시, 자신을 포함한 전장에 있는 새벽 사무소 소속 인격이 2명 이상이면, 모든 새벽 사무소 소속 인격에게 해당 인원 수만큼 새벽 사무소 부여

새벽 사무소 해결사 싱클레어가 전장에 있으면, 다음 효과 발동
- 새벽 사무소 해결사 싱클레어가 새벽에서 노을로 얻음
- 새벽 사무소 대표 그레고르가 사망한 상태면, 턴 시작 시 새벽 사무소 해결사 싱클레어가 보유한 새벽에서 노을로가 타오르는 노을로 변경됨
- 턴 시작 시 새벽 사무소 해결사 싱클레어의 체력이 50% 미만이면, 도주 장치 부여 (전투당 1회)
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, if there are 2+ allied Dawn Office Identities (including this unit) on the field, apply Dawn Office Stack on all Dawn Office Identities equal to the number of Dawn Office Identities on the field If Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair is on the field, activate the following effects: - Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair gains From Dawnbreak to Sunset - Turn Start: If Dawn Office Rep Gregor is defeated, convert From Dawnbreak to Sunset on Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair into Blazing Sunset - Turn Start: If Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair has less than 50% HP, apply Escape Apparatus on that unit (once per Encounter)

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
자신에게 새벽맞이가 있을 때, 기본 공격 스킬 적중시 새벽불 2 얻음

자신 이외의 새벽 사무소 소속 인격이 다음 조건 만족 시, 새벽 사무소 대표 그레고르가 대상 적에게 ‘여명의 섬광’ 사용 (인격별 턴당 1회)
- 기본 스킬 공격 종료 시 적중한 적이 흐트러졌을 때, 대상에게 사용
(해당 스킬 공격 시작 전 이미 흐트러짐 상태였으면 발동하지 않음)
- 새벽 사무소 해결사 파우스트의 ‘사출’, ‘사출-정오’, ‘정오의 해체’ 또는 새벽 사무소 해결사 싱클레어의 ‘낙인’, ‘타오르는 일격’ 공격 종료 시, 적중한 적에게 사용 (흐트러진 대상 우선)

새벽 사무소 해결사 싱클레어가 전장에 있으면, 새벽 사무소 대표 그레고르가 사용하는 기본 스킬의 추가된 코인 적중 시 대상 적의 화상 위력만큼 분노 피해를 추가로 입힘 (최대 10, 턴당 최대 20)
- 화상이 발동한 것으로 취급
ldPassives.descriptionEn: When this unit has Dawnherald, gain 2 Light of Daybreak On Hit using Base Attack Skills When other Dawn Office Identities meet the following conditions, Dawn Office Rep Gregor uses the "Flash of Sunup" Skill against the targeted enemy (once per turn per Identity) - At Base Skill Attack End: If the enemy that was hit is Staggered, use "Flash of Sunup" against said enemy (Does not activate if the said enemy was already Staggered Before Attack of said Skill) - At Attack End of the following Skills, use "Flash of Sunup" on the enemy they hit (prioritize Staggered targets):  · Dawn Office Fixer Faust's "Eject", "Eject - High Noon", and "Dismemberment at High Noon"  · Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair's "Stigmatize" and "Blazing Strike" If Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair is on the field: On Hit using Coins added to Dawn Office Rep Gregor's Base Skills, deal additional Wrath damage equal to Burn on the targeted enemy (max 10; max 20 per turn) - Counts as activating Burn

현재 체력이 가장 많은 아군 1명이 화상이 있는 적에게 공격 적중 시, 진동 2 부여 (턴당 1회)
- 대상의 화상이 10 이상이면, 마지막 코인 적중 시 진동 폭발. 진동 횟수 1 감소 (턴당 1회)

statuses.name: Amplitude Conversion
statuses.desc:
Converts Tremor or already converted Tremor on target to a different type of Tremor.
Potency and Count values do not change over the conversion.

statuses.name: Assist Defense
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- When an ally is about to take an Unopposed Attack from an enemy, consume 1 Stack to redirect the enemy's targeting to self; then, use the unique Skill that activates for Assist Defense
- When there are multiple allies that have Assist Defense Stacks, the ally that has the highest Stack has the highest activation priority
- Does not activate for allies who equipped Defense Skills
- Expires at Turn End

statuses.name: Blazing
statuses.desc:
- Min & Max Speed +1
- This turn's first-used Base Attack Skill gains Final Power +2
- Take 2% HP damage On Hit with the affected Skill (max 10%; this damage does not Stagger or reduce this unit's HP below 1)
- Expires at Turn End

statuses.name: Blazing Sunset
statuses.desc:
- If this unit has 3+ Stagger Thresholds, remove the first Stagger Threshold
- Turn End: If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger; if this unit is at Uptie 3 or higher, replace 1 of its Base Skills with Skill 3
(excluding forced Staggers; once per Encounter; prioritizes the Skill of lowest rank)

- Turn Start: Heal 8 SP
- Passive "Unstable Shell of Ego" effects, Base Attack Skill effects, and Volatile Passion effects cannot reduce this unit's SP below 45

- Turn Start: enter the Volatile E.G.O::Waxen Pinion State, heal 50% HP, and heal SP to max (once per Encounter)
- Volatile E.G.O::Waxen Pinion State is maintained even when this unit has 0 or lower SP at Turn Start

- When in Volatile E.G.O::Waxen Pinion state, gain the following effects:
  · Turn Start: Gain Shield equal to 20% of max HP
  · When hit while this unit has Shield, inflict 2 Burn against the attacker (2 times per turn)
  · Activate Scorchfield on this field

※ Scorchfield effects
- Stores all Burn damage dealt in this zone
- Resets when moving to a different zone
- This value is shared by all characters

statuses.name: Dawn Office
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- Gain 1 Offense Level for every Stack
- Turn Start: At 3 Stack, heal 5 SP
- Turn Start: If all other allied Identities that have "Dawn Office" are defeated, expires

statuses.name: Dawnherald
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- Base Skills that inflict Burn Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn' deal +10% damage
· If the said Skill is a Wrath Skill, deal +15% damage instead

- Base Skills that inflict Burn Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn', gain Clash Power +1
· If this unit is a Dawn Office Identity, gain Base Power +1 instead
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

statuses.name: Escape Apparatus
statuses.desc:
- When this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 10, this unit's HP does not drop below 10 for the turn
- Turn End after the above effect activates: Recover from Stagger and Retreat from the Encounter (excluding forced Staggers; does not count as death; in Encounters where Retreat is disabled, the Retreat effect does not activate and expires at Turn End)
  · In Chain Battles, give this unit's Slots to a Substituted unit and move to the rearmost place in the Backup units' Deployment order (escape from the Encounter entirely if there are no other Backup Units remaining to swap places with next turn. When returning to battle, return in the order they retreated in)
  · When returning to battle, return with the same amount of HP and SP this unit had when it retreated, and eliminate all effects on self save for a select few (if this unit had less than 0 SP when retreating, reset SP to 0 instead)

statuses.name: From Dawnbreak to Sunset
statuses.desc:
- If this unit has 3+ Stagger Thresholds, remove the first Stagger Threshold
- Turn End: If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger; if this unit is at Uptie 3 or higher, replace 1 of its Base Skills with Skill 3
(excluding forced Staggers; once per Encounter; prioritizes the Skill of lowest rank)

- Turn Start: Heal 5 SP
- Passive "Unstable Shell of Ego" effects, Base Attack Skill effects, and Volatile Passion effects cannot reduce this unit's SP below 25

- When in Volatile E.G.O::Waxen Pinion state, gain the following effects:
  · Turn Start: Gain Shield equal to 15% of max HP
  · When hit while this unit has Shield, inflict 1 Burn against the attacker (2 times per turn)
  · Activate Scorchfield on this field

※ Scorchfield effects
- Stores all Burn damage dealt in this zone
- Resets when moving to a different zone
- This value is shared by all characters

statuses.desc:
- Min Speed +2
- On Base Attack Skill Use: Gain Base Power +2 and deal +(45 / # of Coins)% damage

- Apply the following effects to "Sunset Blade"
· On final Coin Hit: If target has 15+ Burn, activate Burn on target; then, reduce target's Burn Count by 1

- Apply the following effects to "Blazing Strike"
· Deal +100% damage
· On Use: Convert all Coins into Unbreakable Coins
· On Hit against an enemy, activate Burn on target; then, reduce target's Burn Count by 1
· On Use: At 3+ Volatile Passion, consume up to 100 Scorchfield
· Deal +1% damage for every Scorchfield consumed (max 100%)

* Scorchfield Effects
- Stores all Burn damage dealt in this zone
- Resets when moving to a different zone
- This value is shared by all characters

statuses.name: Light of Daybreak
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 30
- Can gain up to 20 Stack per turn
- Turn Start: Gain 1 Burn for every 5 Stack; then, gain +1 Burn Count for every 10 Stack
- On Hit using a Base Attack Skill, gain (1 + (Burn on target / 3)) Stack (max 3)
- At 10+ Stack, Base Skills inflict +1 more Burn Potency on enemies
- At 20+ Stack, Base Skills inflict +1 more Burn Count on enemies

statuses.name: Tremor - Scorch
statuses.desc:
- On Tremor Burst, take Wrath Damage equal to (sum of Tremor Potency and Burn Potency / 2), and lose 1 Burn Count
- When hit by Skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise this unit's Stagger Threshold by the effect's Potency
- Turn End: reduce the Count by 1
(Interacts the same way as normal Tremor does to effects that raise or reduce Tremor Potency/Count)

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.desc:
At the end of the turn, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Protection
statuses.desc: Take less damage from skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Tremor

When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor Burst

statuses.name: Courier Trunk - Rodion
statuses.desc:
- Base Value: 0
- Turn Start: gain 3 Stack
- Stack does not expire upon Retreat; it is stored instead
- At 10+ Stack: raise Min & Max Speed values by 1
- At 20+ Stack: Gain 1 Clash Power Up and 1 Slash Damage Up
- At 30+ Stack:
· On Skill Use, take (Stack/3)% HP damage and (Stack/3) SP damage
· On Turn End, take (Stack/2)% HP damage and (Stack/2) SP damage (applies before Retreat)

statuses.name: Power Up
statuses.desc: Skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Strategic R&R Mode
statuses.desc:
- Turn End: Recover from Stagger and Retreat from the Encounter (excluding forced Staggers; does not count as death)
· In Chain Battles, give this unit's Slots to a Substituted unit and move to the rearmost place in the Backup units' Deployment order (escape from the Encounter entirely if there are no other Backup Units remaining to swap places with next turn. When returning to battle, return in the order they retreated in)
· When returning to battle, return with the same amount of HP and SP this unit had when it retreated, and eliminate all effects on self save for a select few (if this unit had less than 0 SP when retreating, reset SP to 0 instead)

statuses.name: Clash Power Up

statuses.desc: Speed increases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

When hit by an attack, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

passives.descriptionEn: If an ally is killed by enemy attack, or if the attacked ally's HP is at less than 25% after the attack: After that Attack, Drifting Blade of Hongyuan Ryōshū uses "Aiding Strike" as an Unopposed Attack against that enemy (once per Encounter) - The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu may activate this effect 1 more time past its usage limit If "Hey, Back Off" is activated via the Passive 'I.L.T.L.T.', the Skill deals +30% damage on Critical Hit and heals 2~4 SP for 1 other ally with the lowest SP (once per turn; excluding allies at -40 or lower SP)

- 홍원 군주 홍루는 횟수 제한을 초과하여 이 효과 1회 추가 발동 가능

‘군.가.곁.좋’ 패시브 효과로 ‘어이, 물러서라’ 발동 시, 해당 스킬 크리티컬 피해량 +30%. 자신을 제외한 정신력이 가장 낮은 아군 1명의 정신력 2 ~ 4 회복 (턴 당 1회. 정신력이 -40 이하인 아군 제외)

statuses.name: Clashable Guard
statuses.desc:
- On Clash Win: raise the target's Stagger Threshold by this unit's final Clash Power.
- On Clash Lose: when hit, reduce the attacker's final Skill Power by this unit's Final Power.
- On Clash Lose: does not gain Final Power from the following sources: Resonance and the Level disparity against the Attack Skill

statuses.name: Protector's Stance
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 2
- Take (Stack x 10)% less damage
- Turn Start: Gain Shield by Poise on self (max 20)
- Turn End: Gain 3 Poise Potency and +1 Poise Count; this unit's leftmost Skill Slot gains +5 Aggro next turn
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

statuses.name: Poise
statuses.desc:
On hit, gain a Potency-based chance to deal critical damage, reducing the Count by 1 if successful.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Rupture
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

- 대상이 마침표 사무소 해결사거나, 대상의 호흡 횟수가 5 미만이면, 대신 4 증가 (턴 당 1회. 탄환이 없는 대상에게는 적용되지 않음)
ldPassives.descriptionEn: 1 ally that has the least Ammo gains +2 Poise Count when using a Skill that consumes Ammo. - If the said ally is a Full-Stop Office Identity, or if they have less than 5 Poise Count, gain +4 Poise Count instead (once per turn; does not apply to units without Ammo)

statuses.name: Ammo - Atelier Logic
statuses.desc:
Unique Ammo
Atelier Logic Workshop Special Ammo
- This Ammo's count cannot be gained or lost due to external effects

statuses.name: Clashable Guard
statuses.desc:
- On Clash Win: raise the target's Stagger Threshold by this unit's final Clash Power.
- On Clash Lose: when hit, reduce the attacker's final Skill Power by this unit's Final Power.
- On Clash Lose: does not gain Final Power from the following sources: Resonance and the Level disparity against the Attack Skill

statuses.name: Concentration【Sniper】
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 4
- Turn End: gain 1 Stack

statuses.name: Melee Support
statuses.desc:
- If unit A applies this effect to unit B: Unit B follows up with an Unopposed Attack with the 'Melee Support' Skill against the same enemy that attacked Unit A. Activates at Unit A's Skill End.
- The Skill used due to the 'Melee Support' effect does not affect Unit B's upcoming Skills list.

statuses.name: Overwatch Assignment
statuses.desc:
- Turn End: Recover from Stagger and Retreat from the Encounter (excluding forced Staggers; does not count as death)
· In Chain Battles, give this unit's Slots to a Substituted unit and move to the rearmost place in the Backup units' Deployment order (escape from the Encounter entirely if there are no other Backup Units remaining to swap places with next turn. When returning to battle, return in the order they retreated in)
· When returning to battle, return with the same amount of HP and SP this unit had when it retreated, and eliminate all effects on self save for a select few (if this unit had less than 0 SP when retreating, reset SP to 0 instead)

statuses.name: Pierce Resist Down
statuses.desc:
Increase Pierce Resistance based on Stack.
(0.1 per Stack)

statuses.name: Power Up
statuses.desc: Skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Reload
statuses.desc: Lose all currently owned Ammo, and reload it back to full

statuses.name: Target Spotted
statuses.desc:
If unit A applies this effect to unit B: Unit B follows up with an Unopposed Attack with its Skill 2 against the same enemy Unit A attacked with its Skill. Activates at Unit A's Attack End.
- The Skill used due to this effect does not affect Unit B's upcoming Skills list.

statuses.name: Ammo
statuses.desc:
Spent by certain skills.
Some attacks cancel if lacking Ammo.

statuses.name: Haste
statuses.desc: Speed increases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Pierce Fragility
statuses.desc: Take more damage from Pierce skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Pierce Power Up
statuses.desc: Pierce skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Poise
statuses.desc:
On hit, gain a Potency-based chance to deal critical damage, reducing the Count by 1 if successful.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

statuses.name: Blue Sand
statuses.desc:
- On Clash Lose, gain +1 Sinking Count (3 times per turn)
- SP Units: change their Panic Type to "Blue Sand"
- Non-SP Units: Min & Max Speed -1
- Turn End: Reduce 1 Stack
- This effect is not cumulative; inflicting it will replace the current value with the inflicted value
- Apply the "Non-SP Units" conditional to certain enemies that have SP but can't change their Panic Types

※ Blue Sand Panic Effects
- Low Morale: Clash Power -1, Min & Max Speed -1
- Panic: Clash Power -2, Min & Max Speed -1

statuses.name: Gloom Resist Down
statuses.desc:
Increase Gloom Resistance based on Stack.
(0.1 per Stack)

statuses.name: LCA Fracture Round
statuses.desc:
- Unique Ammo
- Max Capacity: 16
- Spent by certain Skills
- Some attacks cancel if lacking Ammo

statuses.name: Reload
statuses.desc: Lose all currently owned Ammo, and reload it back to full

statuses.name: Sheut Fracture
statuses.desc:
- Unique Sinking
- Max Stack: 10
- For every Stack, take +1% more damage from Sloth and Gloom Skills
- At max Stack, gain 1 Gloom Fragility (once per turn), take Gloom damage equal to Sinking Potency on self (lose 1 Sinking Count), then expires
- If the unit that has this effect dies, transfer half of its Stack to its ally that has the highest SP (rounded down)
- Turn Start: If there are no LCA Identities on the field, expires

statuses.name: The Udjat [Vanguard]
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 2
- Min & Max Speed +3
- Combat Start: gain 1 Protection
- Gain the following effects during the Combat Phase (once per Skill, 3 times per turn)
· When this unit is the main target of an Unopposed Attack Skill, halve the chance for the Skill's first Coin to flip Heads
· Clash Start: In the first Clash, halve the target's chance to flip Heads for all of its Coins
· For both of the above effects, if the target uses Minus Coins, halve their chance to flip Tails instead
- Turn End: Reduce 1 Stack

statuses.name: Aggro
statuses.desc: In focused encounters, slots with higher Aggro values are more likely to be targeted by enemies.

statuses.name: Gloom Fragility
statuses.desc: Take more damage from Gloom skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Protection
statuses.desc: Take less damage from skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Sinking
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed SP damage by the effect’s Potency.
(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor
statuses.desc:
When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor Burst
statuses.desc: Raise target's Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency on target

On hit, gain a Potency-based chance to deal critical damage, reducing the Count by 1 if successful.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Rupture
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor
statuses.desc:
When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor Burst
statuses.desc: Raise target's Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency on target

스킬 종료시 자신의 호흡 위력 3당, 묵 공방 - 예[銳] 2식 발도 / 추력:도깨비불 1 얻음 (최대 5, 턴당 2회)

SP for Blade Lineage allied Identities excluding this unit Combat Start: If there is an allied Identity at less than 50% HP on the field excluding this unit, gain 1 Assist Defense (once per turn) Skill End: Gain 1 Mook Workshop - Ye -銳- Type II Bladedraw / Thrust Force - Dokkaebi Fire for every 3 Poise Potency on self (max 5, 2 times per turn)

ldPassives.nameEn: Cut Down What Must Be Felled
ldPassives.descriptionKo:
속도가 가장 빠른 아군 1명이 가하는 참격 스킬 피해량 +10%
- 해당 아군에게 신속이 있으면, 대신 참격 스킬 피해량 +15%

statuses.name: Assist Defense
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- When an ally is about to take an Unopposed Attack from an enemy, consume 1 Stack to redirect the enemy's targeting to self; then, use the unique Skill that activates for Assist Defense
- When there are multiple allies that have Assist Defense Stacks, the ally that has the highest Stack has the highest activation priority
- Does not activate for allies who equipped Defense Skills
- Expires at Turn End

statuses.name: Bearing of a Salsu
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- Gain Offense Level for every Stack
- On Attack Hit using Slash Skills, gain 1 Poise (2 times per turn) 
- Lose 1 Stack when an allied Blade Lineage Identity is defeated

statuses.name: Clashable Guard
statuses.desc:
- On Clash Win: raise the target's Stagger Threshold by this unit's final Clash Power.
- On Clash Lose: when hit, reduce the attacker's final Skill Power by this unit's Final Power.
- On Clash Lose: does not gain Final Power from the following sources: Resonance and the Level disparity against the Attack Skill

statuses.name: Dokkaebi Arms
statuses.desc:
- Take -15% damage
- On Skill Use, gain 1 Haste next turn (2 times per turn)
- Combat End: This effect expires, and gain +2 Poise Count

statuses.name: Mook Workshop - Ye [銳] Type II Bladedraw / Thrust Force: Dokkaebi Fire
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 20
- Can gain up to 10 Stacks per turn
- Slash Base Attack Skills deal +1% damage for every Stack (max 10%)
- Defense Skills lose 1 Clash Power for every 2 Stacks (max 5)
- Turn End: Gain 1 Haste next turn for every 5 Stacks (max 3)

statuses.name: Swordplay of the Homeland
statuses.desc:
- When at 5+ Poise, upon Skill use, Skill 1 and Skill 2 gain Coin Power +(3/# of Coins, minimum 1) and deal +(30/# of Coins)% damage on Critical Hit
- When at 7+ Poise, upon Skill use, Skill 3 deals +(30/# of Coins)% damage and deals +(50/# of Coins)% damage on Critical Hit

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Haste
statuses.desc: Speed increases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Paralyze
statuses.desc: Fix the Power of Coins to 0 for one turn, with one Coin per the effect’s Count.

statuses.name: Poise
statuses.desc:
On hit, gain a Potency-based chance to deal critical damage, reducing the Count by 1 if successful.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Slash Fragility
statuses.desc: Take more damage from Slash skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

statuses.desc:
- On Clash Win: raise the target's Stagger Threshold by this unit's final Clash Power.
- On Clash Lose: when hit, reduce the attacker's final Skill Power by this unit's Final Power.
- On Clash Lose: does not gain Final Power from the following sources: Resonance and the Level disparity against the Attack Skill

statuses.name: Dazzle
statuses.desc:
- For every 1 (Sinking + Burn), take +0.5% damage from Base Attack Skills (max 10%)
- SP Units: Change their Panic Type to "Dazzle"
- Non-SP Units: Defense Level -2
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack
- This effect is not cumulative; inflicting it will replace the current value with the inflicted value
- Apply the "Non-SP Units" conditional to certain enemies that have SP but can't change their Panic Types

※ Dazzle Panic-type Effects
- Low Morale: Turn End: Gain 1 Bind and 2 Offense Level Down next turn
- Panic: Turn End: Gain 1 Bind and 4 Offense Level Down next turn

statuses.name: Guardians of the Forest
statuses.desc:
Before Attack, activate the following effects:
- Plus Coin Skills heal 4 SP (if already at max SP, gain 2 Offense Level Up next turn)
- Minus Coin Skills lose 8 SP (this effect cannot reduce the unit's SP below -40)
- Lose this effect

statuses.name: Lamp
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 8
- Turn End: Gain 1 Bind next turn for every 2 Stack (max 4)
- Turn End: At max Stack, if there are enemies on the field, consume all Stack to activate the following effects next turn:
• Gain +10 Aggro to the leftmost Slot
• Inflict 3 Dazzle to the enemy(Core) with the most current HP

statuses.name: Power Up
statuses.desc: Skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Aggro
statuses.desc: In focused encounters, slots with higher Aggro values are more likely to be targeted by enemies.

statuses.name: Bind
statuses.desc: Speed decreases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Blunt DMG Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with Blunt skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.desc:
At the end of the turn, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Clash Power Up
statuses.desc: In a Clash, gain Clash Power equal to the value

statuses.name: Defense Level Up
statuses.desc: Defense Level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Haste
statuses.desc: Speed increases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Pierce DMG Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with Pierce skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Plus Coin Boost
statuses.desc: Raise the Power of Plus Coins by the effect’s Count.

statuses.name: Sinking
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed SP damage by the effect’s Potency.
(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

전투 시작 시 산나비·죽은나비를 각각 10씩 보유함

- 산나비를 소모했으면, 소모한 값만큼 산나비를 부여
- 죽은나비를 소모했으면, 소모한 값만큼 죽은나비를 부여

- 정신력이 0 미만이면, 70% 확률로 산나비를, 30% 확률로 죽은나비를 얻음

statuses.name: Butterfly
statuses.desc:
- Unique Sinking
- Base Value: 0, Max Value: 15
- The Potency and the Count of this effect are called "The Living" and "The Departed", respectively.
- When hit, the attacker heals (The Living/4) SP. (min 1; rounded down)
- When hit, and if this unit's SP is at less than 0, take (Sinking Potency/5) Gloom damage for every value of The Departed. (max Gloom damage 30; rounded down; deals half damage to targets that are Non-SP Units.)
- Turn End: Reset The Departed of this effect to 0; then, gain Sinking equal to The Living and convert The Living into The Departed.
- No external effects can raise the amount of Butterfly inflicted. "Inflict additional Sinking" effects inflict additional Sinking instead of additional Butterfly.
- This effect expires when both The Living and The Departed reach 0.

statuses.name: Reload
statuses.desc:
- Effect applied to The Living & The Departed(Unique Ammo)
- Consume (30 - (The Living + The Departed))/2 SP. (rounded down)
- Reset both The Living and The Departed values on self to 0, and gain the max value of their sum based on the probabilities listed in the Passive 'ISeeTheDyingButterfly.'
- On Reload, gain at least 1 of The Living and The Departed.

statuses.name: The Living & The Departed
statuses.desc:
- Unique Ammo
- The sum of Potency and Count maxes out at 20.
- Consumed for certain Skills.
- Whether The Living(Potency) or The Departed(Count) will be consumed for each shot is randomly determined
- Some attacks cancel if this unit runs out of ammo.

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
다음 효과로 인하여 정신력이 -40 미만으로 내려가지 않음
- 자신이 사용하는 기본 스킬의 정신력 감소 효과
- 아군 서포트 패시브의 정신력 감소 효과
- 눈물 벼리기의 정신력 감소 효과
- 자신의 정신력 감소 효과 조건 중 아군 사망으로 정신력이 감소할 경우
이번 전투에서 정신력이 -45가 되는 피해를 받았을 때, 해당 턴 동안 정신력이 -44로 유지됨 (전투당 1회)
(※ 정신력 피해에만 적용되며, 정신력이 변경되거나, E.G.O 스킬 사용과 같이 정신력을 소모하는 경우에는 적용되지 않음)
ldPassives.descriptionEn: This unit's SP does not drop below -40 from the following effects: - SP loss effects on this unit's Base Skills - SP loss effects from allied units' Support Passives - SP loss effects from Tear-sharpened - SP loss effects from ally death in this unit's 'Base factors decreasing Sanity' In an Encounter, when this unit takes damage that brings its SP to -45, maintain this unit's SP at -44 for that turn (once per Encounter) (※ This applies only to SP damages; it does not apply to SP changes or SP consuming abilities like using E.G.O Skills)

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
꿰뚫는 검을 보유하였다면, 기본 공격 스킬을 사용하여 적에게 적중 전에 꿰뚫는 검을 1 소모하여 침잠 1 부여
- 이번 턴에 마지막으로 사용하는 기본 공격 스킬의 마지막 코인 적중 전에 남은 꿰뚫는 검이 2 이상이면, 대신 전부 소모하여 그 수치만큼 침잠 추가 부여
눈물 벼리기를 3개 보유하였다면, 기본 공격 스킬을 사용하여 적에게 마지막 코인 적중 전에 눈물 벼리기를 전부 소모하여 침잠 3, 침잠 횟수 3을 부여하고 해당 코인의 피해량 +50%
- 이 효과가 발동하였다면, 해당 턴 종료 시 정신력이 0 미만이면 정신력이 0으로 초기화 (패닉 또는 E.G.O 침식 상태일 경우, 해제). 그 후, 정신력 30 회복
ldPassives.descriptionEn: If this unit has Piercing Sword: before hitting an enemy with a Base Attack Skill, consume 1 Piercing Sword to inflict 1 Sinking - If this unit has 2+ Piercing Sword before this turn's final Base Attack Skill's final Coin hits, consume all of it instead to inflict it as Sinking If this unit has 3 Tear-sharpened: before hitting an enemy with the final Coin of a Base Attack Skill, consume all Tear-sharpened to inflict 3 Sinking and +3 Sinking Count, and deal +50% damage with that Coin - If this effect activated, reset to 0 SP if this unit has less than 0 SP at Turn End. (when in Panic or 'E.G.O Corrosion', recover) Then, heal 30 SP

ldPassives.nameEn: Magical Girl of Justice / Knight of Despair

statuses.name: Amplitude Conversion
statuses.desc:
Converts Tremor or already converted Tremor on target to a different type of Tremor.
Potency and Count values do not change over the conversion.

statuses.name: Clashable Guard
statuses.desc:
- On Clash Win: raise the target's Stagger Threshold by this unit's final Clash Power.
- On Clash Lose: when hit, reduce the attacker's final Skill Power by this unit's Final Power.
- On Clash Lose: does not gain Final Power from the following sources: Resonance and the Level disparity against the Attack Skill

statuses.name: Deep Wound
statuses.desc:
- Base Stack: 3
- On Tremor Burst, gain +1 Bleed Count (2 times per turn)
- Cannot gain Open Wound (in Focused Encounters, the Part)
- Turn End: Gain (Stack - 1) Bind next turn
- Turn End: Reduce Stack by 1

statuses.name: Fatal Wound
statuses.desc:
- Base Stack: 3
- On Tremor Burst, gain +3 Bleed Count (2 times per turn)
- Cannot gain Open Wound (in Focused Encounters, the Part)
- Turn End: Gain Bind equal to Stack next turn
- Turn End: Reduce Stack by 1

statuses.name: Open Wound
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 2
- Turn End: Gain 1 Bind next turn
- Turn End: At 2 Stack, replace this effect with Deep Wound next turn

statuses.name: Power Down
statuses.desc: All skills lose final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Power Up
statuses.desc: Skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Tremor - Hemorrhage
statuses.desc:
- On Tremor Burst, take Lust Damage equal to (sum of Tremor Potency and Bleed Potency / 2), and lose 1 Bleed Count
- When hit by Skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise this unit's Stagger Threshold by the effect's Potency
- Turn End: reduce the Count by 1
(Interacts the same way as normal Tremor does to effects that raise or reduce Tremor Potency/Count)

statuses.name: Bind
statuses.desc: Speed decreases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Defense Level Down
statuses.desc: Defense Level decreases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Defense Power Down
statuses.desc: Defense skills lose final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Haste
statuses.desc: Speed increases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Pierce Power Up
statuses.desc: Pierce skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Tremor
statuses.desc:
When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor Burst
statuses.desc: Raise target's Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency on target

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

passives.descriptionKo:
자신이 저격 자세 상태면, 가장 왼쪽에 장착한 기본 공격 스킬을 ‘섬궁’으로 변경하여 전투 시작 시 사용함.
- 이 효과 발동시 자신의 목표 조준이 최대 수치이고, 조작 패널과 예비 스킬 슬롯에 스킬 3이 없으면, 
가장 왼쪽 슬롯에 장착한 수비 스킬을 스킬 3으로 취급하여 ‘섬궁’으로 변경함

사용하는 기본 공격 스킬에 따라 아래 효과 적용 (죄악 속성은 사용한 스킬 속성을 따름)
- 스킬 1: 기본 위력 +1, 피해량 +11%
- 스킬 2: 기본 위력 +1, 코인 위력 +1, 피해량 +22%

statuses.name: Prisoner Transport Arrangements
statuses.desc:
- Base Stack: 1
- In a Clash against enemies that have Trussed [Hong Lu], Clash Power +1
- On Hit against enemies that have Trussed [Hong Lu], inflict 1 Bleed and gain 1 Poise (2 Skills per turn)
- If there are no Trussed targets, expires

statuses.name: Trussed
statuses.desc:
- Base Stack: 3
- Fix this unit's Speed to 1
- Fix this unit's Base Skills' Coin Power to 0
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack
- If the "Prisoner Transport Arrangements" buff on the inflicter expires, this effect expires as well

statuses.name: Trussed [Hong Lu]
statuses.desc:
- Base Stack: 3
- Min & Max Speed -2
- Take +10% Pride damage
- Expires when the inflicter Retreats, is killed, or inflicts it on a different target. Replaced when Trussed by another unit
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack if the inflicter did not hit this unit this turn

statuses.name: Attack Power Down
statuses.desc: Attack skills lose final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Bind
statuses.desc: Speed decreases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Haste
statuses.desc: Speed increases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Poise
statuses.desc:
On hit, gain a Potency-based chance to deal critical damage, reducing the Count by 1 if successful.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Pride Fragility
statuses.desc: Take more damage from Pride skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

- 가장 왼쪽 슬롯의 아래 스킬 우선 변경
- 대행 [헤르메스]가 9 미만이면 스킬 3으로 발동됨
(75 - 카르마 / 2)% 확률로 참격 무기가 등장
- 참격 무기 코인 피해량 +25%
이 스킬에 지령 표식이 새겨졌으면, 피해량 +20%
자신의 호흡과 대상의 침잠의 합 6당, 코인 위력 +1 (최대 2)
[사용시] (해금 단계 + 1)만큼 마지막 코인부터 파괴 불가 코인으로 변경됨
[사용시] 자신의 호흡 횟수 3 증가
- 해금 단계만큼 호흡 추가로 얻음
[적중시] 호흡 3 얻음
[적중시] 침잠 3 부여

해금 단계 1당 피해량 +20% (최대 60%)
[크리티컬 적중 시] 자신의 호흡 횟수 1 증가
[파괴되지 않고 적중시] 침잠 횟수 3 증가

coinEffects:
At Unlock - III, Coin Power +2
[Combat Start] Gain +2 Poise Count (once per turn)
[On Evade] Gain 2 Poise (2 times per turn)
[Turn End] At below Unlock - II, activate the following effects (once per Encounter):
- Gain Unlock - II
- If Grace of the Prescript Stack is less than 6, raise the Stack to 6
- Gain 5 Karmic Consequence at the start of the next turn for every Grace of the Prescript gained via the effect above
coinEffectsKo:
해금 - Ⅲ이면, 코인 위력 +2
[전투 시작시] 호흡 횟수 2 증가 (턴당 1회)
[회피 성공시] 호흡 2 얻음 (턴당 2회)
[턴 종료 시] 해금 - Ⅱ 미만이면, 다음 효과 발동 (전투당 1회)
- 해금 - Ⅱ 얻음
- 6 미만인 지령의 가호가 6으로 변경됨
- 증가한 지령의 가호 1당 다음 턴 시작 시 카르마 5 얻음

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
턴 시작 시,
- 자신의 해금 단계에 따라 지령[단말기] I/지령[단말기] II/지령[단말기] III/지령[단말기] IV 얻음
- 무작위 적 1명에게 지령 대상 부여 (집중 전투면, 부위에 부여)
- 조작 슬롯의 자신의 기본 공격 스킬에 지령 표식 부여 (슬롯당 1개, 최대 2개 부여)
· 해금 - II 이상이면, 스킬 3에 우선 부여 (강화된 스킬 우선)
- 흐트러짐, 행동 불가, 패닉, E.G.O 침식 상태면, 위의 모든 효과와 지령 수행 여부가 적용되지 않음
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Turn Start: - Gain Prescript: -Device- I (Yi Sang) / Prescript: -Device- II (Yi Sang) / Prescript: -Device- III (Yi Sang) / Prescript: -Device- IV (Yi Sang) based on Unlock stage on self - Inflict The Prescript's Target to a random enemy (in Focused Encounters, a Part) - Apply Mark of the Prescript to Base Attack Skills on this unit's Dashboard (1 per Slot, max 2 Skills)  · At Unlock - II+, the effect above prioritizes Skill 3 (prioritizes empowered Skill) - All of the effects above and Prescript (Device) execution checks do not trigger when this unit is Staggered, immobilized, in Panic, or in E.G.O Corrosion

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
해금 - II 미만일 때 이번 턴에 지령을 수행했으면,
턴 종료 시 정신력 4 회복, 지령의 가호 1 얻음 (턴당 1회)
- 지령 수행 시 메인 타겟에게 지령 대상이 있으면,
대신 정신력 8 회복, 지령의 가호 3 얻음

해금 - II일 때 이번 턴에 지령[단말기] III을 수행했으면,
턴 종료 시 정신력 4 회복 (턴당 1회)
- 지령 수행 시 대행 [헤르메스]가 9가 되었으면,
대신 정신력 8 회복, 지령의 가호 3 얻음

이번 턴에 지령을 수행하지 못했으면,
턴 종료 시 카르마 5 얻음
- 해금 - III이면, 카르마를 얻지 않음
- 전투 시작 시 지령 수행을 시도했으나, 전투 중에 대상을 타겟할 수 없게 되었으면, 턴 종료 시 카르마를 얻지 않음 (해금 - II 미만일 때 적용)

턴 종료 시 지령의 가호가 3/6/9이면, 해금 - I/해금 - II/해금 - III 얻음
턴 시작 시 해금 - III이면, 신(心) - 운명 얻음
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Turn End: If Prescript (Device) was executed this turn at below Unlock - II, heal 4 SP and gain 1 Grace of the Prescript (once per turn) - When executing Prescript (Device), if the main target has The Prescript's Target, heal 8 SP and gain 3 Grace of the Prescript instead Turn End: If this unit is at Unlock - II and Prescript (Device) was executed this turn, heal 4 SP - When executing Prescript (Device), if Procuration -Hermes- has reached 9 Stacks, heal 8 SP and gain 3 Grace of the Prescript instead Turn End: If Prescript (Device) was not executed this turn, gain 5 Karmic Consequence - At Unlock - III, does not gain Karmic Consequence - If this unit attempted to execute Prescript (Device) at Combat Start, but could not target the enemy during the combat phase, does not gain Karmic Consequence at Turn End (applies below Unlock - II) Turn End: At 3/6/9 Grace of the Prescript, gain Unlock - I / Unlock - II / Unlock - III Turn Start: At Unlock - III, gain Shin (心) - Fate

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
스테이지에 첫 등장 시, 상처를 가린 가면 얻음
- 이 효과를 보유 중일 때 이번 전투에서 처음으로 흐트러지면, 턴 종료 시 흐트러짐을 해제(강제 흐트러짐 제외)하고 상처를 가린 가면이 이글거리는 상처로 변경됨

검지 대행자 - 개화 E.G.O::대행 돈키호테가 자신과 함께 전장에 있으면, 돈키호테에게 인정 욕구 충족 부여
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, gain Wound-casing Mask - Turn End: If this unit was Staggered for the first time in this Encounter while under this effect, recover from Stagger (excluding forced Stagger) and convert Wound-casing Mask to Sizzling Wound Apply Desire for Acknowledgement Sated to The Index Proxy - Effloresced E.G.O::Procuration Don Quixote when both units are on the field

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
기본 공격 스킬의 코인마다 무기가 무작위로 정해져 특수 효과가 적용됨
- 손도끼로 갈비뼈를 찍어 내릴 때는...
- 스틸레토로 허파를 꿰뚫을 때는...
- 바스타드 소드로 어깨와 머리를 짓이길 때는...
- 레이피어로 몸에 10개 이상의 구멍을 내야할 때는...
- 망치로 뒤통수를 으깨야 할 때는...
- 커다란 검으로 몸통을 갈라야 할 때는...
- 랜스로 20인치의 구멍을 내야 할 때는...
- 채찍으로 살점을 만 갈래 떼어내야 할 때는...
- 낫으로... 누군가처럼 공간을 따라 베어내야 할 때는...

지령 표식 스킬 사용 시, 대행 [헤르메스] 1 얻음

이번 전투에서 'Furioso-Replica'를 처음 사용하였다면, 해당 턴 종료 시 상처를 가린 가면이 이글거리는 상처로 변경됨

턴 시작 시 이글거리는 상처를 보유 중일 때 조작 슬롯에 'Furioso-Replica'가 있으면 지령 탐닉 얻음
ldPassives.descriptionEn: A random weapon is assigned to every Coin for Base Attack Skills. Each weapon has a unique effect. - When hacking through the ribs with a hatchet... (Yi Sang) - When penetrating the lungs with a stiletto... (Yi Sang) - When cleaving through the shoulder and the skull with a bastard sword... (Yi Sang) - When punching 10 or more holes in the torso with a rapier... (Yi Sang) - When caving in the back of the skull with a hammer... (Yi Sang) - When rending the body with a great sword... (Yi Sang) - When boring a 20-inch hole with a lance... (Yi Sang) - When ripping the flesh to ten thousand strips with a whip... (Yi Sang) - When lacerating through space itself with a scythe, like a certain someone... (Yi Sang) Gain 1 Procuration -Hermes- when using Skills with Mark of the Prescript Convert Wound-casing Mask to Sizzling Wound at the end of the turn this unit used "Furioso-Replica" for the first time in this Encounter Turn Start: If this unit has Sizzling Wound and has "Furioso-Replica" on the Dashboard, gain Indulgence in Prescripts

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
자신의 지령의 가호 1당 지령 표식 스킬 피해량 +2% (최대 16%)
- 지령의 가호가 9면, 대신 기본 스킬 피해량 +20%

기본 공격 스킬의 파괴 불가 코인 적중 시, 대행 [헤르메스] 1 얻음
- 공격 종료 시, 남은 파괴 불가 코인 수만큼 대행 [헤르메스] 얻음
- 'Furioso-Replica' 공격 종료 시, (남은 파괴 불가 코인 수/2)만큼 다음 턴에 대행 [헤르메스] 얻음 (소수점 버림)

턴 종료 시 이번 턴에 대행 [헤르메스]가 증가하여 9가 되었을 때, 다음 턴 시작 시 조작 슬롯에 스킬 3이 없으면, 기본 스킬 하나를 스킬 3으로 변경 (가장 왼쪽 슬롯의 아래 스킬 우선)
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Deal +2% damage with Skills marked with Mark of the Prescript for every Grace of the Prescript on self (max 16%) - At 9 Grace of the Prescript, deal +20% damage with Base Skills instead On Hit with Base Attack Skill's Unbreakable Coins, gain 1 Procuration -Hermes- - Attack End: Gain Procuration -Hermes- equal to (# of remaining Unbreakable Coins) - "Furioso-Replica" Attack End: Gain Procuration -Hermes- next turn equal to (# of this Skill's remaining Unbreakable Coins / 2) (rounded down) If Procuration -Hermes- reached 9 Stacks this turn at Turn End, and if this unit does not have a Skill 3 on the Dashboard at the start of the next turn, convert a Base Skill to Skill 3 (prioritizes the Skill on the leftmost Slot's bottom row)

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
이번 턴에 아군이 적에게 처음으로 사용한 참격, 관통, 타격 기본 공격 스킬의 피해량이 각각 +5%
- 효과가 적용된 스킬이 검지 소속 인격의 스킬이면, 대신 피해량이 추가로 +10%
- 공격 시작 전 기준으로 적용됨
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Deal +5% damage with Slash, Pierce, and Blunt Base Attack Skills that are used for the first time by any ally each turn (once per type across all allies) - The Index Identities deal +10% damage instead - This effect's application is determined Before Attack

statuses.name: Desire for Acknowledgement
statuses.desc:
- For every Stack, Deal +5% damage to and take +5% damage from Ryōshū (max 100%)
- Final Power +1 for every 5 Stack when attacking Ryōshū as the main target (max 4)
- At 10+ Stack, lose 5 SP upon Clash Lose
- Max Stack: 20

statuses.name: Desire for Acknowledgement Sated
statuses.desc:
- Deal +7.5% damage with Skills marked with Mark of the Prescript
- Deal +7.5% damage against The Prescript's Targets

statuses.name: Grace of the Prescript
statuses.desc:
- Offense Level +1 for every 3 Stacks
- Max Stack: 9

statuses.name: Indulgence in Prescripts
statuses.desc:
- Min & Max Speed +5
- Apply the following effects to 'Furioso-Replica':
· On Hit, inflict +1 more Sinking Potency and gain +1 more Poise Potency
· On Hit, inflict +3 Sinking Count (once per target)
· Deal +30% damage
- Expires at Turn End

statuses.name: Karmic Consequence
statuses.desc:
- Turn Start:
· Gain 1 Defense Level Down for every 10 Stacks
· Gain 1 Fragile for every 20 Stacks
- Max Stack: 100

statuses.name: Mark of the Prescript
statuses.desc: - Apply Mark of the Prescript to a Base Attack Skill on this unit's Dashboard

statuses.name: Prescript
statuses.desc: Receive Prescript: [Device] under specific conditions

statuses.name: Prescript: [Device] I
statuses.desc:
Use a Skill marked with Mark of the Prescript or hit a target with a marked Skill.

- Turn Start: Gain this effect when this unit has no Unlock
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 3

statuses.name: Prescript: [Device] II
statuses.desc:
Hit a target with a Skill marked with Mark of the Prescript.

- Turn Start: Gain this effect if this unit has Unlock - I
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 6

statuses.name: Prescript: [Device] III
statuses.desc:
Gain Procuration [Hermes]. Repeat this Prescript until Procuration [Hermes] reaches 9 Stacks.

- Turn Start: Gain this effect if this unit has Unlock - II
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 9

statuses.name: Prescript: [Device] IV
statuses.desc:
Eliminate all enemies before the next Prescript arrives.

- Turn Start: Gain this effect if this unit has Unlock - III

statuses.name: Procuration [Hermes]
statuses.desc:
- Turn Start: At 9 Stack, a powerful Skill becomes available
- Can be gained up to (Unlock stage + 2) Stack per turn
- Max Stack: 9
· At below Unlock - II, this effect's maximum Stack is limited to 8

statuses.name: Shin (心) - Fate
statuses.desc:
- Min & Max Speed +1
- Gain +1 more Poise Potency and Count from Base Skills
- If this unit's SP is higher than the target's, deal +1% damage for every 3 SP difference (max 15%; Non-SP Units are considered to be at 0 SP)

statuses.name: Sizzling Wound
statuses.desc:
- Offense Level +3, Defense Level -3
- Take -25% damage from Unopposed Attacks
- Turn Start: Gain 1 Burn and 1 Bleed
- Deal +15% damage with Base Attack Skill's Unbreakable Coins

statuses.name: The Prescript's Target
statuses.desc:
- Take +10% damage from The Index units
- This effect is applied to a single target every turn regardless of the number of The Index units deployed

statuses.name: Unfocused Volley
statuses.desc:
- When this Skill flips Coins, each Coin flips against a random enemy among its targets
· The first Coin always targets the main target
· All 'On Hit' effects and all damage dealt by each Coin are inflicted only against the random target the Coin selected

statuses.name: Unlock
statuses.desc:
- Gain this effect when over certain Grace of the Prescript Stack
- Effect stage increases based on Grace of the Prescript Stack
- Max: Stage 3

statuses.name: Unlock - I
statuses.desc:
- Defense Level +1
- Combat End: Heal 5 SP

statuses.name: Unlock - II
statuses.desc:
- Defense Level +2
- Combat End: Heal 10 SP

statuses.name: Unlock - III
statuses.desc:
- Defense Level +3
- Combat End: Heal 15 SP

statuses.name: When boring a 20-inch hole with a lance...
statuses.desc:
- This Coin deals Pierce damage
- This Coin deals +15% damage
- On Hit without Cracking, inflict 1 Pierce Fragility until next turn (2 times per turn)

statuses.name: When caving in the back of the skull with a hammer...
statuses.desc:
- This Coin deals Blunt damage
- This Coin deals +5% damage
- On Hit without Cracking, raise target's Stagger Threshold by 3

statuses.name: When cleaving through the shoulder and the skull with a bastard sword...
statuses.desc:
- This Coin deals Slash damage
- This Coin deals +5% damage
- On Hit without Cracking, gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn (2 times per turn)

statuses.name: When hacking through the ribs with a hatchet...
statuses.desc:
- This Coin deals Blunt damage
- On Hit without Cracking, gain 2 Poise

statuses.name: When lacerating through space itself with a scythe, like a certain someone...
statuses.desc:
- This Coin deals Slash damage
- This Coin deals +30% damage
- On Hit without Cracking, it hits a guaranteed Crit

statuses.name: When penetrating the lungs with a stiletto...
statuses.desc:
- This Coin deals Pierce damage
- On Hit without Cracking, inflict 2 Sinking

statuses.name: When punching 10 or more holes in the torso with a rapier...
statuses.desc:
- This Coin deals Pierce damage
- This Coin deals +5% damage
- On Hit without Cracking, inflict 1 Defense Level Down next turn (2 times per turn)

statuses.name: When rending the body with a great sword...
statuses.desc:
- This Coin deals Slash damage
- This Coin deals +15% damage
- On Hit without Cracking, inflict 1 Slash Fragility until next turn (2 times per turn)

statuses.name: When ripping the flesh to ten thousand strips with a whip...
statuses.desc:
- This Coin deals Blunt damage
- This Coin deals +15% damage
- On Hit without Cracking, inflict 1 Blunt Fragility until next turn (2 times per turn)

statuses.name: Wound-casing Mask
statuses.desc:
- Offense Level +2, Defense Level -2
- Take -10% damage from Unopposed Attacks

statuses.name: Bind
statuses.desc: Speed decreases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.desc:
At the end of the turn, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Fragile
statuses.desc: Take more damage from skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Paralyze
statuses.desc: Fix the Power of Coins to 0 for one turn, with one Coin per the effect’s Count.

statuses.name: Poise
statuses.desc:
On hit, gain a Potency-based chance to deal critical damage, reducing the Count by 1 if successful.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Sinking
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed SP damage by the effect’s Potency.
(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

name: The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael

passives.name: Thermal Weapon
passives.descriptionEn: This unit is considered as an "Identity that inflicts Burn and Bleed" If this unit has Thermal Blades, Skills that inflict Bleed are considered as Skills that inflict both Burn and Bleed
passives.descriptionKo:
이 인격은 화상, 출혈을 부여하는 인격으로 취급됨.
열선 효과를 보유하고 있을 시, 출혈을 부여하는 스킬이 이 효과로 인해서 화상과 출혈을 부여하는 스킬로 취급됨.
effects: This unit is considered as an "Identity that inflicts Burn and Bleed" If this unit has Thermal Blades, Skills that inflict Bleed are considered as Skills that inflict both Burn and Bleed

passives.name: The Middle Never Forgets, Y'know?
passives.descriptionEn: Turn End: Inflict Vengeance Mark to the enemy that dealt the most Skill damage to an ally this turn Every time this unit is hit by an enemy, gain 2 The Middle - Grudge (Ishmael) (2 times per turn) When another The Middle-faction ally is hit by an enemy, gain 1 The Middle - Grudge (Ishmael) (once per turn per Identity) - If target that attacked this unit or an ally has Vengeance Mark, gain 1 more The Middle - Grudge (Ishmael) - Combat Start: If the Dashboard has Envy A-Reson., double the amount of The Middle - Grudge (Ishmael) gained this turn Gain 1 The Middle Styled Augmentation Tattoos (Ishmael) every time this unit consumes 5 The Middle - Grudge (Ishmael) (2 times per turn) Combat Start: If this unit does not have Thermal Blades, and at 3+ Envy Reson., gain 2 Thermal Blades next turn Combat Start: If this unit has Thermal Blades, gain (Envy Reson. / 3) Thermal Blades at Turn End (max 2)
passives.descriptionKo:
턴 종료 시 이번 턴에 아군에게 스킬로 가장 많이 피해를 준 적 1명에게 앙갚음 대상 부여
자신이 적에게 피격당할 때마다 중지 - 원한 2 얻음 (턴당 2회)
자신을 제외한 중지 소속 아군이 피격당할 때마다 중지 - 원한 1 얻음 (인격 별로 턴당 1회)
- 자신이나 아군을 공격한 대상이 앙갚음 대상이면, 추가로 1 얻음
- 전투 시작 시 질투 완전 공명이 있으면, 이번 턴에 중지 - 원한을 2배로 얻음

clientPassives.name: Book of Vengeance - The House of Spiders Special Clause
clientPassives.desc:
Turn End:
- Apply [RetaliationBook] on the unit that dealt the most Skill damage to an ally
- Apply [RetaliationBookSpiderOutis] on the unit that dealt the most Skill damage to this unit

Combat Start: Gain 1 [ResentmentSpiderOutis] for every Envy Reson. (max 7)

If the following conditions are met during the Combat Phase, gain 2 [ResentmentSpiderOutis]
- When this unit is hit by another unit's Skill (2 times per turn)
- When The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael is hit by another unit's Skill (once per turn)

If the following conditions are met during the Combat Phase, gain 1 [ResentmentSpiderOutis] (this unit and The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael getting hit do not count toward either conditional below)
- When a The Middle ally is hit by another unit's Skill (once per turn per Identity)
- When a The House of Spiders ally is hit by another unit's Skill (once per turn per Identity)

When this unit gains [ResentmentSpiderOutis], if the target has [RetaliationBook], gain an additional Stack of [ResentmentSpiderOutis]

Gain 1 [ReinforcedTattooSpiderOutis] every time this unit consumes 5 [ResentmentSpiderOutis]

【Effects apply only to The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael】
When The House of Spiders: The Middle Nursefather Outis is hit by another unit's Skill, Ishmael gains 2 [ResentmentIshmael] (once per turn)

If this unit's sword has [MiddleFatherSwordTwoOutis] or [MiddleFatherSwordThreeOutis], Skills that inflict [Laceration] are considered as Skills that inflict both [Combustion] and [Laceration]

clientPassives.desc:

At less than 80% HP, use "Time to Unpack!" as an Unopposed Attack at Skill End, converting [MiddleFatherSwordOneOutis] into [MiddleFatherSwordTwoOutis]

clientPassives.name: Sealed Sword [Lævateinn]
clientPassives.desc:
Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, gain [MiddleFatherSwordOneOutis]

<style="highlight">When each Seal is removed from the sword, gain [CountSkillMidOutis] corresponding to the unsealing stage
- [MiddleFatherSwordOneOutis]: Gain 1 [CountSkillMidOutis]
- [MiddleFatherSwordTwoOutis]: Gain 2 [CountSkillMidOutis]
- [MiddleFatherSwordThreeOutis]: Gain 2 [CountSkillMidOutis]

When the following conditions are met, lose 1 [CountSkillMidOutis] (once per turn)
- Upon using the "Stamp of Vengeance" Skill, lose 1 Stack (including "Stamp of Vengeance" activation via Counter)
- At 6+ sum of Envy A-Reson, lose 1 Stack at Turn End

At 0 [CountSkillMidOutis] Stack, use "Time to Unpack!" as an Unopposed Attack at Skill End
- Turn End: At 0 [CountSkillMidOutis] Stack, and if this unit failed to use "Time to Unpack!" in that turn, use "Time to Unpack!" at the next turn's Combat Start
- While this unit's sword has [MiddleFatherSwordOneOutis], at less than 80% HP, use "Time to Unpack!" regardless of [CountSkillMidOutis] Stack

At 50%- HP, gain 3 [MiddleFatherGutsOutis] (once per Encounter)

When Staggered for the first time in this Encounter, recover from Stagger at Turn End and gain 15 [ResentmentSpiderOutis] (excluding forced Staggers)

Turn Start: At 15 [ResentmentSpiderOutis], replace a Base Skill on this unit's Dashboard with "Stamp of Vengeance" or "Complete and Total Extermination" (3 times per Encounter)
- Applies only on the Skill on the leftmost Slot's bottom row on the Dashboard
- This effect does not activate if either "Stamp of Vengeance" or "Complete and Total Extermination" is already in the affected Slot</style>

clientPassives.name: Parenting

- 해당 슬롯에 이미 해당 스킬이 있는 경우 발동하지 않음

턴 종료 시 해당 턴에 자신에게 스킬로 가장 많이 피해를 준 적 1명에게 앙갚음 장부 [거미집]을 부여
전투 시작 시 질투 공명 1당 중지 - 원한 1 얻음 (최대 7)
전투 중 아래 조건을 만족 시 중지 - 원한 2 얻음
- 자신이 다른 캐릭터의 스킬로 피격 시 (턴당 2회)
- 거미집 중지 제자 이스마엘이 다른 캐릭터의 스킬로 피격 시 (턴당 1회)
전투 중 아래 조건을 만족 시 중지 - 원한 1 얻음 (자신과 중지 제자 이스마엘은 대상에서 제외)
- 중지 소속 아군이 다른 캐릭터의 스킬로 피격 시 (인격별 턴당 1회)
- 거미집 소속 아군이 다른 캐릭터의 스킬로 피격 시 (인격별 턴당 1회)
자신이 중지 - 원한을 얻을 때 대상이 앙갚음 대상이면, 추가로 1 얻음
자신이 중지 - 원한을 5 소모할 때마다 중지 - 원한 문신 [큰 누님] 1 얻음
[거미집 중지 제자 이스마엘 전용 효과]
거미집 중지 아비 오티스가 다른 캐릭터의 스킬로 피격 시, 이스마엘이 중지 - 원한 2 얻음 (턴당 1회)
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Turn End: - Apply Vengeance Mark on the unit that dealt the most Skill damage to an ally - Apply Book of Vengeance -The House of Spiders- on the unit that dealt the most Skill damage to this unit Combat Start: Gain 1 The Middle - Grudge (Outis) for every Envy Reson. (max 7) If the following conditions are met during the Combat Phase, gain 2 The Middle - Grudge (Outis) - When this unit is hit by another unit's Skill (2 times per turn) - When The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael is hit by another unit's Skill (once per turn) If the following conditions are met during the Combat Phase, gain 1 The Middle - Grudge (Outis) (this unit and The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael getting hit do not count toward either conditional below) - When a The Middle ally is hit by another unit's Skill (once per turn per Identity) - When a The House of Spiders ally is hit by another unit's Skill (once per turn per Identity) When this unit gains The Middle - Grudge (Outis), if the target has Vengeance Mark, gain an additional Stack of The Middle - Grudge (Outis) Gain 1 The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo -Great Sister- every time this unit consumes 5 The Middle - Grudge (Outis) 【Effects apply only to The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael】 When The House of Spiders: The Middle Nursefather Outis is hit by another unit's Skill, Ishmael gains 2 The Middle - Grudge (Ishmael) (once per turn)

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
전투 시작시 반격을 장착한 아군에게 피해량 증가 1, 보호 1 부여 (전투당 최대 2번 발동 가능, 합 가능 반격 제외)
- 효과를 받는 아군이 중지 소속이면, 대신 질투 피해량 증가 2, 보호 2 부여
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Combat Start: Apply 1 Damage Up and 1 Protection on allies that equipped Counter Skills (2 times per Encounter; excluding Clashable Counters) - If the affected ally is in The Middle, apply 2 Envy DMG Up and 2 Protection instead

statuses.name: Avenging My Family
statuses.desc:
- Envy Base Skills deal +20% damage
- Base Skills gain Final Power +1

statuses.name: Book of Vengeance [The House of Spiders]
statuses.desc:
- Against units that have this effect, The House of Spiders: The Middle Nursefather Outis and The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael heal 5 SP On Hit using a Skill (once per Skill, 2 times per turn)
- On Hit using a Skill against The House of Spiders: The Middle Nursefather Outis, gain 1 additional Stack of The Middle - Grudge (once per Skill, 2 times per turn for each Identity)
- On Hit using a Skill against The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael, gain 1 additional Stack of The Middle - Grudge (once per Skill, 2 times per turn for each Identity)
- Expires at Turn End

statuses.name: Check This Out, Kiddo!
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 10
- Reduced by 1 when this unit is hit by 2 Skills
- At 5+ Stack, Base Skills gain Final Power +1
- Blunt Skills deal +1% damage for every Stack (max 10%)

statuses.name: Entanglement
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 4
- Skill and Passive effects can increase Min & Max Stack of this effect to 5 and 9, respectively

statuses.name: Fever
statuses.desc:
Deal +10% damage per Count
Reduced by 1 at turn end

statuses.name: First Seal Removed
statuses.desc:
- Turn End: Gain 1 Haste next turn
- Blunt Base Skills deal +2% damage for every 4 (Burn + Bleed) on target (max 10%)
- On final Coin Hit using Base Skills, if target has 20+ (Burn + Bleed), deal (10% of the Coin's final damage) Blunt damage (rounded down)

statuses.name: I Got Praised!
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 10
- Reduced by 1 when this unit is hit by 2 Skills
- At 5+ Stack, Base Skills gain Final Power +1
- Blunt Skills deal +1% damage for every Stack (max 10%)

statuses.name: Lævateinn
statuses.desc:
- Turn Start: Inflict 3 Burn on all units on the field
- Replace this unit's Base Skills with Lævateinn-exclusive Skills corresponding to each Skill's rank
- Blunt Base Skills deal +2% damage for every 4 (Burn + Bleed) on target (max 10%)
- On final Coin Hit using Base Skills, if target has 20+ (Burn + Bleed), deal (10% of the Coin's final damage) Pierce damage (rounded down)

statuses.name: Ridiculous Grit
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- Fix any Attack Type Resistances that exceed Normal (1.0) to Normal (unless Staggered)
- Take -(30 + (The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Sister] Stack x 4))% damage from Skills (max 50%; rounded down)
- On Clash Win, heal an additional (Clash count x 5) SP (max 15)
- Turn End: If this unit lost SP this turn due to its Skill effects, deal +10% damage next turn using Base Skills (once per turn)
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

statuses.name: Rising Fever
statuses.desc:
Lose 1 Stack when meeting one of the following conditions (once per turn):
- Using the "Stamp of Vengeance" Skill (including activation via Counter)
- At Turn End after activating 6+ Envy A-Reson.

At 0 Stack, use the "Time to Unpack!" Skill

statuses.name: Sealed Sword
statuses.desc:
- Turn End: Gain 2 Haste next turn
- Blunt Base Skills deal +2% damage for every 4 Bleed on target (max 10%)
- On final Coin Hit using Base Skills, if target has 20+ Bleed, deal (10% of the Coin's final damage) Blunt damage (rounded down)

statuses.name: Second Seal Removed
statuses.desc:
- Turn End: Gain 1 Haste next turn
- Blunt Base Skills deal +2% damage for every 4 (Burn + Bleed) on target (max 10%)
- On final Coin Hit using Base Skills, if target has 20+ (Burn + Bleed), deal (10% of the Coin's final damage) Slash damage (rounded down)

statuses.name: The Middle - Grudge
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 15
- If target has Vengeance Mark, deal +20% damage

statuses.name: The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Sister]
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 10
- Final Power +1 for Base Skills for every 5 Stack (max 2)
- Envy Skills and Blunt Skills deal +5% damage for every Stack (max 50%)

statuses.name: Vengeance
statuses.desc:
- Low Morale
- Turn Start: Gain 1 Attack Power Up and 3 Defense Level Down. Gain Damage Up based on the amount of damage taken last turn (1 Damage Up for every 3% of Max HP lost)

statuses.name: Vengeance Mark
statuses.desc: Applied to the unit that dealt the most damage to an ally (Max 1)

statuses.name: Vengeance Tattoo
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 20
- Base Skills deal +1% damage for every Stack

statuses.name: Aggro
statuses.desc: In focused encounters, slots with higher Aggro values are more likely to be targeted by enemies.

statuses.name: Bind
statuses.desc: Speed decreases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Blunt DMG Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with Blunt skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.desc:
At the end of the turn, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Damage Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Envy DMG Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with Envy skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Envy Fragility
statuses.desc: Take more damage from Envy skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Offense Level Up
statuses.desc: Offense level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Paralyze
statuses.desc: Fix the Power of Coins to 0 for one turn, with one Coin per the effect’s Count.

statuses.name: Protection
statuses.desc: Take less damage from skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

statuses.name: Artwork: Fascia
statuses.desc:
Apply the following effects to this unit's Base Attack Skills and Clashable Counter Skill based on Corpus Ingredient Potency:
- 1+ : Base Power +1
- 2+ : If the enemy has Bleed or 'Unique Bleed', deal +10% damage
- 3+ : Inflict +1 more Bleed Potency and Count
- 4+ : Base Power +1

statuses.name: Assist Defense
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- When an ally is about to take an Unopposed Attack from an enemy, consume 1 Stack to redirect the enemy's targeting to self; then, use the unique Skill that activates for Assist Defense
- When there are multiple allies that have Assist Defense Stacks, the ally that has the highest Stack has the highest activation priority
- Does not activate for allies who equipped Defense Skills
- Expires at Turn End

statuses.name: Clashable Guard
statuses.desc:
- On Clash Win: raise the target's Stagger Threshold by this unit's final Clash Power.
- On Clash Lose: when hit, reduce the attacker's final Skill Power by this unit's Final Power.
- On Clash Lose: does not gain Final Power from the following sources: Resonance and the Level disparity against the Attack Skill

statuses.name: Corpus Ingredient
statuses.desc:
- Max Count: 20
- Unique Charge
- Interacts the same way as normal Charge does to effects that raise or reduce Charge Potency and Count
- Turn End: Lose 1 Count

statuses.name: Iron Maiden
statuses.desc:
- Gain +4 Aggro to the leftmost Slot
- Turn Start: Gain 1 Protection, 5 Defense Level Up, and Shield HP equal to 5% of this unit's current HP
- When hit by the last Coin of an attacker, deal Pierce damage equal to 20% of the said Coin's damage and inflict +2 Bleed Count (max once per Skill, 3 times per turn. Max damage per turn: 60)

statuses.name: Somatic Frisson-inspiring Melody
statuses.desc:
- Min & Max Speed +1
- Base Attack Skills gain Clash Power +1 and deal +10% damage

statuses.name: The Self Unbound - Flow State
statuses.desc:
- Min & Max Speed +2
- Gain a new set of Base Skills
- Deal +20% damage with Base Attack Skills to enemies whose Speed is slower than this unit

statuses.name: Bind
statuses.desc: Speed decreases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Charge
statuses.desc: Resource used by certain skills for additional effects. Its Count can go up to 20. Count lowers by 1 at the end of each turn.

statuses.name: Damage Down
statuses.desc: Deal less damage with skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Defense Level Down
statuses.desc: Defense Level decreases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Defense Level Up
statuses.desc: Defense Level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Haste
statuses.desc: Speed increases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Slash DMG Up
statuses.desc: Deal more damage with Slash skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
자신의 완성되어가는 교본과 메인 타겟 적의 결투 고조 수치 합에 따라 다음 효과 전부 얻음
- 수치 1당, 기본 스킬로 가하는 피해량 +3% (최대 15%)
- 1 : 합 위력 +1
- 2 : 기본 스킬의 기본 위력 +1
- 3 : 기본 스킬의 공격 적중 시, 다음 턴에 힘줄 절단 1 부여
- 4 : 기본 스킬의 최종 위력 +1
- 5 : 기본 스킬의 피해량 +15%
자신의 완성되어가는 교본과 자신을 공격하는 적의 결투 고조 수치 합 1당, 받는 피해량 -3% (최대 15%)
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Gain the following effects based on (Maturing Textbook on self + The Duel Escalates (Heathcliff) on the main target) - Base Skills deal +3% damage for every combined Stack (max 15%) - 1+ Stack: Clash Power +1 - 2+ Stack: Base Skills gain Base Power +1 - 3+ Stack: On Hit using a Base Skill, inflict 1 Severed Tendon (Heathcliff) next turn - 4+ Stack: Base Skills gain Final Power +1 - 5+ Stack: Base Skills deal +15% damage Take -3% damage for every (Maturing Textbook on self + The Duel Escalates (Heathcliff) on the enemy attacking this unit) (max -15%)

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
속도가 가장 빠른 아군 1명이 기본 공격 스킬로 합 승리 시,
대상 적의 화상 횟수 1 증가 (턴당 1회)
- 엄지 소속 인격에게 우선 적용
- 엄지 소속 인격이면 효과가 강화되어, 대신 대상의 화상 횟수와 진동 횟수 1 증가
- 전투 시작 시 적이 1명만 있으면(환상체일 경우, 본체 기준), 이 패시브 효과로 부여하는 화상 횟수와 진동 횟수 +1
ldPassives.descriptionEn: 1 ally with the fastest Speed: On Clash Win using Base Attack Skills, inflict +1 Burn Count on target (once per turn) - Prioritizes "The Thumb" Identities - If the ally is "The Thumb" Identity, inflict +1 Burn Count and Tremor Count instead - Combat Start: If there is only 1 enemy on the field, (for Abnormalities, a Core), this effect inflicts +1 more Burn Count and Tremor Count

statuses.name: Amplitude Conversion
statuses.desc:
Converts Tremor or already converted Tremor on target to a different type of Tremor.
Potency and Count values do not change over the conversion.

statuses.name: Assist Defense
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- When an ally is about to take an Unopposed Attack from an enemy, consume 1 Stack to redirect the enemy's targeting to self; then, use the unique Skill that activates for Assist Defense
- When there are multiple allies that have Assist Defense Stacks, the ally that has the highest Stack has the highest activation priority
- Does not activate for allies who equipped Defense Skills
- Expires at Turn End

statuses.name: Clashable Guard
statuses.desc:
- On Clash Win: raise the target's Stagger Threshold by this unit's final Clash Power.
- On Clash Lose: when hit, reduce the attacker's final Skill Power by this unit's Final Power.
- On Clash Lose: does not gain Final Power from the following sources: Resonance and the Level disparity against the Attack Skill

statuses.name: Entanglement
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 4
- Skill and Passive effects can increase Min & Max Stack of this effect to 5 and 9, respectively

statuses.name: Eye of Precognition
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 30
- Can lose up to 10 Stacks per turn

statuses.name: Eye of Precognition - Overheat
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 30
- Offense Level +3, Defense Level -3
- Turn Start: Gain 10 Stacks
- At 30 Stacks, convert into "Eye of Precognition"

statuses.name: Maturing Textbook
statuses.desc:
- Base Skills deal +(10 + (Stack x 5))% damage
- Can gain up to 2 Stacks per turn
- Max Stack: 3

statuses.name: Overheat
statuses.desc:
- Loses this effect when this unit gains Savage Tigermark Round
- Min & Max Speed +2
- Base Attack Skills Lose (cumulative number of Tigermark & Savage Tigermark Rounds spent / 2) Clash Power (max 10); however, gain the following effects(cumulative):
· 8+ Rounds spent: Gain 1 Protection for every 10% missing HP on self at Turn Start (max 5)
· 14+ Rounds spent: On Clash Lose, Unbreakable Coins of this unit's Base Attack Skills deal +(75 + missing HP percentage on self)% damage (max 150%)
· 20+ Rounds Spent: Deal +(HP percentage difference)% damage against targets with higher remaining HP percentage than this unit (max 50%; except E.G.O Skills)

statuses.name: Severed Tendon
statuses.desc:
- Base Power -1
- Expires at Turn End
- Max Stack: 1

statuses.name: The Duel Escalates
statuses.desc:
- Affects The House of Spiders: The Thumb Apprentice Heathcliff's Skills and Passive effects
- Can gain up to 3 Stacks per turn
- Max Stack: 5

statuses.name: Tremor - Scorch
statuses.desc:
- On Tremor Burst, take Wrath Damage equal to (sum of Tremor Potency and Burn Potency / 2), and lose 1 Burn Count
- When hit by Skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise this unit's Stagger Threshold by the effect's Potency
- Turn End: reduce the Count by 1
(Interacts the same way as normal Tremor does to effects that raise or reduce Tremor Potency/Count)

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.desc:
At the end of the turn, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Protection
statuses.desc: Take less damage from skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Tremor
statuses.desc:
When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor Burst
statuses.desc: Raise target's Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency on target

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

- At 5 Stacks, Base Skill Coin Power +1
- Expires at Skill End

- Max Capacity: 10
- Unique Ammo
- Spent by certain Skills

statuses.name: Amplitude Conversion
statuses.desc:
Converts Tremor or already converted Tremor on target to a different type of Tremor.
Potency and Count values do not change over the conversion.

- Skill and Passive effects can increase Min & Max Stack of this effect to 5 and 9, respectively

statuses.name: Eye of Precognition
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 30
- Can lose up to 10 Stacks per turn

statuses.name: Eye of Precognition - Overheat
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 30
- Offense Level +3, Defense Level -3
- Turn Start: Gain 10 Stacks
- At 30 Stacks, convert into "Eye of Precognition"

statuses.name: Game Target
statuses.desc: - Take +15% damage from Base Skills used by The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather Rodion

statuses.name: Overheat
statuses.desc:
- Loses this effect when this unit gains Savage Tigermark Round
- Min & Max Speed +2
- Base Attack Skills Lose (cumulative number of Tigermark & Savage Tigermark Rounds spent / 2) Clash Power (max 10); however, gain the following effects(cumulative):
· 8+ Rounds spent: Gain 1 Protection for every 10% missing HP on self at Turn Start (max 5)
· 14+ Rounds spent: On Clash Lose, Unbreakable Coins of this unit's Base Attack Skills deal +(75 + missing HP percentage on self)% damage (max 150%)
· 20+ Rounds Spent: Deal +(HP percentage difference)% damage against targets with higher remaining HP percentage than this unit (max 50%; except E.G.O Skills)

statuses.name: Reload
statuses.desc: Lose all currently owned Ammo, and reload it back to full

statuses.name: Shin (心) - Disgrace
statuses.desc:
- Min & Max Speed +1
- Base Skills inflict +1 more Tremor and Burn Potency and Count
- Deal +3% damage for every 3 Poise Potency on self (max 15%)

statuses.name: Tremor - Scorch
statuses.desc:
- On Tremor Burst, take Wrath Damage equal to (sum of Tremor Potency and Burn Potency / 2), and lose 1 Burn Count
- When hit by Skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise this unit's Stagger Threshold by the effect's Potency
- Turn End: reduce the Count by 1
(Interacts the same way as normal Tremor does to effects that raise or reduce Tremor Potency/Count)

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.desc:
At the end of the turn, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Haste
statuses.desc: Speed increases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Offense Level Up
statuses.desc: Offense level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Poise
statuses.desc:
On hit, gain a Potency-based chance to deal critical damage, reducing the Count by 1 if successful.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor
statuses.desc:
When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor Burst
statuses.desc: Raise target's Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency on target

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1
