statuses.name: Assist Defense
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- When an ally is about to take an Unopposed Attack from an enemy, consume 1 Stack to redirect the enemy's targeting to self; then, use the unique Skill that activates for Assist Defense
- When there are multiple allies that have Assist Defense Stacks, the ally that has the highest Stack has the highest activation priority
- Does not activate for allies who equipped Defense Skills
- Expires at Turn End

statuses.name: Battlefield Retreat
statuses.desc:
- Turn End: Recover from Stagger and Retreat from the Encounter (excluding forced Staggers; does not count as death)
· In Chain Battles, give this unit's Slots to a Substituted unit and move to the rearmost place in the Backup units' Deployment order (escape from the Encounter entirely if there are no other Backup Units remaining to swap places with next turn. When returning to battle, return in the order they retreated in)
· When returning to battle, return with the same amount of HP and SP this unit had when it retreated, and eliminate all effects on self save for a select few (if this unit had less than 0 SP when retreating, reset SP to 0 instead)

statuses.name: Clashable Guard
statuses.desc:
- On Clash Win: raise the target's Stagger Threshold by this unit's final Clash Power.
- On Clash Lose: when hit, reduce the attacker's final Skill Power by this unit's Final Power.
- On Clash Lose: does not gain Final Power from the following sources: Resonance and the Level disparity against the Attack Skill

statuses.name: Contamination
statuses.desc: Combat Start: Speed -2.

statuses.name: Exalted Command
statuses.desc:
- If unit A applies this effect to unit B: Unit B follows up with an Unopposed Attack with its Base Skill 3 against the same enemy unit A attacked with its Skill. Activates at unit A's Attack End. (Does not activate as Empowered Skills)
- The Skill used as an Assist Attack does not affect Unit B's upcoming Skills list.
- Does not activate if affected ally's Skill 3 is not unlocked.

statuses.name: Heishou Bolus Contamination [黑獣丸染]
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 11
- Empowers The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu based on which Heishou he activated combo with
- The Heishou Bolus Contamination effects can stack with each other

· Heishou - Mao Adept Faust: take -5% damage from Skills
· Heishou - Mao Ryōshū: if this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, deal +5% damage
· Heishou - Mao Outis: inflict +1 Rupture Count On Hit with Unopposed Attacks (once per turn)
· Heishou - Si Rodion: Inflict 1 Rupture On Critical Hit (3 times per turn)
· Heishou - Si Gregor: Gain +1 Poise Count when dealing Rupture damage (once per turn)

statuses.name: Leash-holder of All Heishou
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 11
- Gain the following effects based on Stack:
· For every 1 Stack, gain 1 Max Speed (max 5) and deal +1% damage with Skills
· For every 2 Stack, gain 1 Min Speed (max 2) and 1 Defense Level Up (max 5)
· For every 3 Stack, gain 1 Offense Level Up (max 3)
· At 5+ Stack, gain 1 Damage Up and apply 1 Offense Level Up to all Heishou Pack Identities

statuses.name: Life from Death [死中求活]
statuses.desc:

- Turn Start: activate the following

passives.name: Bloodfeast
passives.descriptionEn: If this unit is on field, or is one of the units that can appear on this Stage, increase Bloodfeast value by the amount of Bleed damage collectively received by every unit. When this unit enters the field, the sleeping blood drenching the battlefield will fill the surface. 이 캐릭터가 전투에 등장해있거나 등장할 리스트에 포함되어 있으면, 1턴부터 모든 캐릭터가 받은 출혈 피해만큼 혈찬이 증가함

statuses.name: Bloodfeast
statuses.desc:
- Max Value: 999
- Stores all Bleed damage dealt in this zone
- Resets when moving to a different zone
- This value is shared by all characters
- If there is a higher Kindred among the allies who also consumes Bloodfeast, this unit cannot consume Bloodfeast until that ally consumes it first.

statuses.name: Bloodfeast Consumed
statuses.desc:
- Max Value: 999
- Displays the total amount of Bloodfeast consumed in this Encounter

statuses.name: Bloodfeast Consumed (shared)
statuses.desc: Total Bloodfeast consumed in this Encounter

statuses.name: Hardblood
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 10
- Stage 1 Hardblood
- At 10+ Hardblood, converts to Hardblood II.
- At 20+ Hardblood, converts to Hardblood III.
- Reverts to the previous Stage when the Stack drops below the requirements.
- Hardblood does not drop below 1.
- Raise Min & Max Speed values by 1 for every 10 Hardblood
- At Hardblood II, gain 1 Offense Level Up based on the Stack
- At Hardblood III, gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up based on the Stack

statuses.name: Responsibility
statuses.desc:
- Max Value: 1
- Clash Power +1
- Deal +20% damage
- Take +20% damage

statuses.name: Shimmering【Bloodfiend】
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 50
- As long as this effect exists, all Bleed damage taken by the Shield HP is converted to Bloodfeast.
- Gain Shield HP equal to the Stack at the moment of its application
- Expires at Turn End

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Damage Up

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin

- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

statuses.name: Ailing Heart
statuses.desc:
- Max Value: 10
- Turn End: gain 1 Stack
- Turn Start: gain 1 Defense Level Up for every 3 Stack
- At 50%- HP, gain 1 Defense Level for every 3 Stack
- At 40%- HP, On Hit with Base Skills, heal (Stack x 5)% of damage dealt On Hit as HP (min 1; rounded down; heal up to 30 HP per Skill)

statuses.name: Bloodfeast
statuses.desc:
- Max Value: 999
- Stores all Bleed damage dealt in this zone
- Resets when moving to a different zone
- This value is shared by all characters
- If there is a higher Kindred among the allies who also consumes Bloodfeast, this unit cannot consume Bloodfeast until that ally consumes it first.

statuses.name: Bloodied Hand
statuses.desc:
- Max Value: 10
- Stage 1 Bloodied Hand
- At 10+ Bloodied Hand, converts to Bloodied Hand II.
- At 20+ Bloodied Hand, converts to Bloodied Hand III.
- Reverts to previous Stage when the Stack drops below the requirements.
- At Bloodied Hand II, gain 1 Offense Level Up based on the Stack
- At Bloodied Hand III, gain 1 Offense Level Up based on the Stack, and additionally inflict 1 Rupture and 1 Bleed On Hit with Base Skills

statuses.name: Aggro
statuses.desc: In focused encounters, slots with higher Aggro values are more likely to be targeted by enemies.

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Rupture

When hit by an attack, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Bloodfeast
statuses.desc:
- Max Value: 999
- Stores all Bleed damage dealt in this zone
- Resets when moving to a different zone
- This value is shared by all characters
- If there is a higher Kindred among the allies who also consumes Bloodfeast, this unit cannot consume Bloodfeast until that ally consumes it first.

statuses.name: Focused Performance
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
-  Identities only; includes Empowered Skills
- Skill 1 and Skill 2 gain Final Power +1; deal +5% damage for every Stack (max 15%)
- Skill 3 gains Final Power +2; deals +10% damage for every Stack (max 30%)
- Lose 1 Stack when:
  1) Skill 3 Attack End
  2) If this unit does not have Hardblood Armor at Turn Start

statuses.name: Hardblood
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 10
- Stage 1 Hardblood
- At 10+ Hardblood, converts to Hardblood II.
- At 20+ Hardblood, converts to Hardblood III.
- Reverts to the previous Stage when the Stack drops below the requirements.
- Hardblood does not drop below 1.
- Raise Min & Max Speed values by 1 for every 10 Hardblood
- At Hardblood II, gain 1 Offense Level Up based on the Stack
- At Hardblood III, gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up based on the Stack

statuses.name: Hardblood Armor
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 5
- If this unit isn't at max HP: after its Skill attack, heal 10% of HP damage dealt (once per turn; max 40 healing)
- Attack End: If this unit dealt HP damage, lose 1 Stack (once per turn)
• If Lust Reson. was activated, halve the amount of HP healed, but do not lose any Hardblood Armor Stack

statuses.name: La Mancha Parade
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 4
- Take +10% damage from Lust Skills
• If the target is a  Identity, take +20% damage regardless of the Skill's Affinity
• At max Stack, deal -20% damage against  Identities
- Lose 1 Stack either after this unit's Skill hits and ends or after the Skill that attacked this unit hits and ends

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Defense Level Up
statuses.desc: Defense Level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Haste
statuses.desc: Speed increases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Lust Fragility
statuses.desc: Take more damage from Lust skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Offense Level Up
statuses.desc: Offense level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Rupture
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

ldPassives.descriptionEn: Inflict +1 more Mauled Color -Rouge-, Mauled Color -Bleu-, and Touche Hardie

ldPassives.nameEn: Nice and Slow, Don't Let It Break...
ldPassives.descriptionKo:
편성 순서가 가장 빠른 인격에게 아래 효과 적용
- 색욕 공명 수가 홀수면, 출혈 위력 부여량 +1
- 색욕 공명 수가 짝수면, 침잠 위력 부여량 +1
- 해당 인격이 약지 소속 인격이면, 전투 시작시 공격 레벨 증가 1 또는 방어 레벨 증가 1을 얻음
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Apply the following effects to the Identity with the earliest Deployment order: - If Lust Reson. is of an odd number, inflict +1 more Bleed Potency - If Lust Reson. is of an even number, inflict +1 more Sinking Potency - If the said Identity is in The Ring faction, it gains 1 Offense Level Up or 1 Defense Level Up at Combat Start

statuses.name: L'Hommage
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- Turn Start: Randomly gain 1 Offense Level Up or 1 Defense Level Up for every Stack (max 3 times)
- Turn End: This effect expires

statuses.name: Le Fauvisme - Masque de Loup
statuses.desc:
- Min & Max Speed +1
- Inflict +1 more Bleed and Sinking Potency with Base Skills
- On Hit, if target has 3+ Mauled Color [Bleu], inflict +1 Sinking Count (once per turn)
- On Hit, if target has 3+ Mauled Color [Rouge], inflict +1 Bleed Count (once per turn)

statuses.name: Mauled Color [Bleu]
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 9
- When hit, gain 1 Sinking Potency for every 3 Stack (once per turn)
- Turn End: At 5+ Stack, lose 5 SP
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

statuses.name: Mauled Color [Rouge]
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 9
- When hit, gain 1 Bleed Potency for every 3 Stack (once per turn)
- Turn End: Gain 1 Defense Level Down next turn for every 4 Stack (max 2)
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

statuses.name: Palette Vibrante
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 4
- Take +(Stack x 2.5)% damage from The Ring-faction Identities
· If the attacker is in both The Ring faction and School of Fauvism faction, take +(Stack x 5)% damage instead
- Combat Start: Randomly gain 1 Bleed, 1 Sinking, 1 Bleed Count, or 1 Sinking Count (Stack) times
- Combat End: This effect expires. Halve Mauled Color [Rouge] and Mauled Color [Bleu] Stacks on this unit (rounded down)

statuses.name: Power Up
statuses.desc: Skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Réflexion
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 2
- Cannot use "Critique" during the turn this unit has this effect
- Turn Start: Heal 5 SP
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack
- When this effect expires, gain L'Hommage next turn equal to the number of The Ring Student Identities on the field

statuses.name: Touche Hardie
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 2
- Take +10% HP and SP damage from Bleed and Sinking effects for every Stack (max 20%, rounded down)
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

statuses.name: Unfocused Volley
statuses.desc:
- When this Skill flips Coins, each Coin flips against a random enemy among its targets
· The first Coin always targets the main target
· All 'On Hit' effects and all damage dealt by each Coin are inflicted only against the random target the Coin selected

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Clash Power Up
statuses.desc: In a Clash, gain Clash Power equal to the value

statuses.name: Defense Level Up
statuses.desc: Defense Level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Offense Level Up
statuses.desc: Offense level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Sinking
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed SP damage by the effect’s Potency.
(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

statuses.desc:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Burn

At the end of the turn, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Offense Level Up
statuses.desc: Offense level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Rupture
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Sinking
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed SP damage by the effect’s Potency.
(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor
statuses.desc:
When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

(탄환이 없으면 적용되지 않음. 단, 탄환 버프는 보유하였으나 수치가 0인 경우에는 효과가 적용됨)
ldPassives.descriptionEn: When 1 ally with the fastest Speed uses a Skill that spends Ammo, if their Speed is faster than the target's by 3 or more, deal +(Speed difference x 3)% more damage (max 15%) (This effect does not activate if the affected unit lacks the Ammo buff entirely. However, it will activate if they have the Ammo buff, even if they have 0 rounds left)

statuses.name: Amplitude Conversion
statuses.desc:
Converts Tremor or already converted Tremor on target to a different type of Tremor.
Potency and Count values do not change over the conversion.

statuses.name: Overheat
statuses.desc:
- Loses this effect when this unit gains Savage Tigermark Round
- Min & Max Speed +2
- Base Attack Skills Lose (cumulative number of Tigermark & Savage Tigermark Rounds spent / 2) Clash Power (max 10); however, gain the following effects(cumulative):
· 8+ Rounds spent: Gain 1 Protection for every 10% missing HP on self at Turn Start (max 5)
· 14+ Rounds spent: On Clash Lose, Unbreakable Coins of this unit's Base Attack Skills deal +(75 + missing HP percentage on self)% damage (max 150%)
· 20+ Rounds Spent: Deal +(HP percentage difference)% damage against targets with higher remaining HP percentage than this unit (max 50%; except E.G.O Skills)

statuses.name: Savage Tigermark Round
statuses.desc:
- Unique Ammo
- At 8+ (cumulative sum of Tigermark Rounds and Savage Tigermark Rounds spent), gain Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星] instead of Tiantui Star [天退星] from this unit's Passive
- Activates the same way as Tigermark Round does
- Max Capacity: 8

statuses.name: Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星]
statuses.desc:
- Min & Max Speed +3
- If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's by 3 or more, deal +(Speed difference x 5)% damage (max 40%)
- Inflict +2 more Tremor Potency and Tremor Count with this unit's Skills
- Max Stack: 1

statuses.name: Tiantui Star [天退星]
statuses.desc:
- Min & Max Speed +1
- If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's by 3 or more, deal +(Speed difference x 2.5)% damage (max 20%)
- Inflict +1 more Tremor Potency and Tremor Count with this unit's Skills
- If this unit has spent 8+ (sum of Tigermark Round and Savage Tigermark Round): at Turn End, convert this buff to Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星] next turn
- Max Stack: 1

statuses.name: Tigermark Round
statuses.desc:
- Unique Ammo
- At 8+ (cumulative sum of Tigermark Rounds and Savage Tigermark Rounds spent), gain Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星] instead of Tiantui Star [天退星] from this unit's Passive
- Max Capacity: 12

statuses.name: Tremor - Scorch
statuses.desc:
- On Tremor Burst, take Wrath Damage equal to (sum of Tremor Potency and Burn Potency / 2), and lose 1 Burn Count
- When hit by Skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise this unit's Stagger Threshold by the effect's Potency
- Turn End: reduce the Count by 1
(Interacts the same way as normal Tremor does to effects that raise or reduce Tremor Potency/Count)

statuses.name: Ammo
statuses.desc:
Spent by certain skills.
Some attacks cancel if lacking Ammo.

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.desc:
At the end of the turn, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor
statuses.desc:
When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor Burst
statuses.desc: Raise target's Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency on target

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

passives.descriptionKo:
상시 적용: 작열 추진탄 15 보유
스킬이나 패시브로 작열 추진탄을 소모했다면, 다음 턴에 소모한 만큼 피해량 증가를 얻음 (턴 당 최대 3)
작열 추진탄을 소모하는 코인을 굴릴 때, 작열 추진탄이 없는 경우에도 공격이 취소되지 않는 대신 해당 코인의 적중 시 화상 부여, 화상 횟수 증가 효과가 발동하지 않음
effects: Always Active: begin Encounters with 15 Scorch Propellant Ammo If this unit spent Scorch Propellant Ammo with Skills or Passives, gain Damage Up equal to the amount spent next turn (max 3) When flipping a Coin that consumes Scorch Propellant Ammo: while not having Scorch Propellant Ammo does not cancel this unit's attacks, the Coin's On Hit "inflict Burn" and "inflict Burn Count" effects do not activate

passives.name: Ammunition Tribute
passives.descriptionEn: When the 1 ally Identity with the earliest Deployment order among those using Ammo finishes their attack, if their current Ammo count is fewer than half (rounded up), spend Scorch Propellant Ammo on self equal to the total Ammo count the affected unit spent, and supply them with the same amount of Ammo as Scorch Propellant Ammo this unit just spent. (can spend up to 5 ammunition) (once per Encounter) - If the Ammo receiving Identity is a Thumb Identity of a higher rank, supply 1 additional Ammo they use - If the Ammo receiving Identity has separate values for Potency and Count, they will be supplied at random. - If either Potency or Count is maxed out, supply whichever is not maxed.
passives.descriptionKo:
탄환을 쓰는 인격 중 편성 순서가 가장 빠른 아군 1명의 공격이 종료 되었을 때, 해당 인격의 현재 보유 탄환이 절반 미만이면 (소수점 올림), 해당 인격이 소모한 탄환 수 만큼 자신의 작열 추진탄을 소모하고, 작열 추진탄을 소모한 만큼 해당 인격이 사용하는 탄환을 보급함. (최대 소모 값: 5개) (전투당 1회)

- 탄환을 보급 받는 인격이 자신보다 계급이 높은 엄지 소속 인격이면, 해당 인격이 사용하는 탄환을 1개 더 보급함
- 위력, 횟수가 분리된 탄환은 위력, 횟수를 무작위로 보급함
- 만약 위력 또는 횟수가 최댓값인 경우, 최댓값이 아닌 쪽의 탄환으로 보급함
effects: When the 1 ally Identity with the earliest Deployment order among those using Ammo finishes their attack, if their current Ammo count is fewer than half (rounded up), spend Scorch Propellant Ammo on self equal to the total Ammo count the affected unit spent, and supply them with the same amount of Ammo as Scorch Propellant Ammo this unit just spent. (can spend up to 5 ammunition) (once per Encounter) - If the Ammo receiving Identity is a Thumb Identity of a higher rank, supply 1 additional Ammo they use - If the Ammo receiving Identity has separate values for Potency and Count, they will be supplied at random. - If either Potency or Count is maxed out, supply whichever is not maxed.

- 만약 위력 또는 횟수가 최댓값인 경우, 최댓값이 아닌 쪽의 탄환으로 보급함

(can spend up to 5 ammunition) (once per Encounter) - If the Ammo receiving Identity is a Thumb Identity of a higher rank, supply 1 additional Ammo they use - If the Ammo receiving Identity has separate values for Potency and Count, they will be supplied at random. - If either Potency or Count is maxed out, supply whichever is not maxed.

- 탄환을 사용하는 인격이 없으면, 이 효과는 발동하지 않음

statuses.name: Amplitude Conversion
statuses.desc:
Converts Tremor or already converted Tremor on target to a different type of Tremor.
Potency and Count values do not change over the conversion.

statuses.name: Borrowed Time
statuses.desc:
Turn End at 2+ Count:
- Gain (Borrowed Time Count - 1) Haste, Clash Power Up, and Fragile next turn
- If this unit is set to gain more Bind than Haste next turn, the Borrowed Time effect expires at the next Turn Start, and this unit gets Staggered

Turn End: At 1 Count, gain 2(Borrowed Time Stack - 1) Bind next turn
Turn End: Gain 1 Stack, lose 1 Count

statuses.name: Time Moratorium
statuses.desc:
- Does not take any damage as long as this effect is active; store all damage received instead
- Combat End: If there is only 1 Count left of this effect, the effect triggers Tremor Burst (Stack) times after dealing (100 + (Stack x 15))% of stored damage as Sloth damage
- Turn End: Gain 1 Stack and lose 1 Count
- The Time Moratorium will immediately expire after triggering the Tremor Burst and the Sloth damage effect if another instance of Time Moratorium is inflicted on a unit that has Time Moratorium.

statuses.name: Tremor - Chain
statuses.desc:
- Lose 1 Clash Power for every 10 Tremor Potency on self (max 3)
- When Hit by Skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect's Potency
- Turn End: reduce the Count by 1

statuses.name: Amplitude Conversion
statuses.desc:
Converts Tremor or already converted Tremor on target to a different type of Tremor.
Potency and Count values do not change over the conversion.

statuses.name: Amplitude Entanglement
statuses.desc:
- Fuses the effects of the Tremor type added by Amplitude Entanglement and the Tremor type currently on target together under Tremor - Superposition.
- Potency and Count values do not change over Entanglement.
- When triggering Amplitude Conversion on Tremor - Superposition, it activates as Amplitude Entanglement instead.
- Turn End: converted into base Tremor.

statuses.name: Borrowed Time
statuses.desc:
Turn End at 2+ Count:
- Gain (Borrowed Time Count - 1) Haste, Clash Power Up, and Fragile next turn
- If this unit is set to gain more Bind than Haste next turn, the Borrowed Time effect expires at the next Turn Start, and this unit gets Staggered

Turn End: At 1 Count, gain 2(Borrowed Time Stack - 1) Bind next turn
Turn End: Gain 1 Stack, lose 1 Count

statuses.name: Clashable Guard
statuses.desc:
- On Clash Win: raise the target's Stagger Threshold by this unit's final Clash Power.
- On Clash Lose: when hit, reduce the attacker's final Skill Power by this unit's Final Power.
- On Clash Lose: does not gain Final Power from the following sources: Resonance and the Level disparity against the Attack Skill

statuses.name: Entanglement
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 4
- Skill and Passive effects can increase Min & Max Stack of this effect to 5 and 9, respectively

statuses.name: Time Moratorium
statuses.desc:
- Does not take any damage as long as this effect is active; store all damage received instead
- Combat End: If there is only 1 Count left of this effect, the effect triggers Tremor Burst (Stack) times after dealing (100 + (Stack x 15))% of stored damage as Sloth damage
- Turn End: Gain 1 Stack and lose 1 Count
- The Time Moratorium will immediately expire after triggering the Tremor Burst and the Sloth damage effect if another instance of Time Moratorium is inflicted on a unit that has Time Moratorium.

statuses.name: Tremor - Chain
statuses.desc:
- Lose 1 Clash Power for every 10 Tremor Potency on self (max 3)
- When Hit by Skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect's Potency
- Turn End: reduce the Count by 1
- (Interacts the same way as normal Tremor does to effects that raise or reduce Tremor Potency/Count)

statuses.name: Violent Collections
statuses.desc:
- If this unit has Haste, gain +1 more Tremor Count from its Base Skills
- If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, deal +(Speed difference x 3)% damage (max 15%)

statuses.name: Bind
statuses.desc: Speed decreases by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Tremor
statuses.desc:
When attacked by skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect’s Potency.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Tremor Burst
statuses.desc: Raise target's Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency on target

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

다음 턴에 자신보다 편성 순서가 빠른 아군의 충전 횟수 2 증가

- 전장에 자신보다 편성 순서가 빠른 아군이 없으면, 대신 자신의 충전 횟수 4 증가

- Gain Charge Count equal to Stack lost

· Attack End of Skills that hit this unit (lose 1 Stack)
· Attack End (lose 3 Stack)
· Turn End (lose 5 Stack)
- Max Stack: 20
- This unit's HP cannot drop below 1 before this effect expires

Then, reduce its Count by 1.

passives.descriptionKo:
상시 적용: 포자탄[기본] 10개, 포자탄[산탄] 6개 보유
포자탄을 소모하는 코인 적중 시
- 포자탄[기본]을 소모했으면, 포자 2 부여
- 포자탄[산탄]을 소모했으면, 포자 3 부여
- 이 효과는 스킬에서 부정적인 효과를 부여하는 것으로 취급됨

- 스킬 사용 중 포자탄이 부족하면, 다음 코인을 모두 취소하고 재장전[포자보충]
포자가 있는 대상 사망 시 충성 페로몬 1 얻음
‘우리 연구팀에서 확인해본 결과, 환상체에서 정제 추출한 안정된 장비라 해도 사용자에 따라 미묘한 변형이 일어나더군.
불완전해서라기보단... 진짜 E.G.O처럼 오히려 완전해지는 과정이라고 보아야 할지.
우선 그걸 변조라 이름 붙이도록 하지.’

statuses.desc:

- Turn Start: At 0~2 Grace of the Prescript, gain this effect 
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 3

statuses.desc:
Hit a target with a Skill marked with Mark of the Prescript.

- Turn Start: At 3~5 Grace of the Prescript, gain this effect
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 6

statuses.name: Prescript: [Paper Slip] III

Hit a target with E.G.O Awakening Skill or 'Skill 3' marked with Mark of the Prescript.

- Turn Start: At 6~8 Grace of the Prescript, gain this effect
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 9

statuses.name: Prescript: [Paper Slip] IV
statuses.desc:

- Turn Start: At 9 Grace of the Prescript, gain this effect

statuses.name: The Prescript's Target
statuses.desc:
- Take +10% damage from The Index units
- This effect is applied to a single target every turn regardless of the number of The Index units deployed

statuses.name: Poise
statuses.desc:
On hit, gain a Potency-based chance to deal critical damage, reducing the Count by 1 if successful.
At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1.

statuses.name: Sinking
statuses.desc:
When hit by an attack, take fixed SP damage by the effect’s Potency.
(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)
Then, reduce its Count by 1.

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

clientPassives.desc:
Gain 1 [ChargeRougeAlly] for every 10 cumulative [ChargeRougeAlly] Count this unit consumes in this Encounter

HP consumption effects from this unit's Base Skills do not Stagger or reduce this unit's HP below 1
(At 1 HP, Base Skill effects that consume HP will be activated for free)

- If this unit entered [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state via its Defense Skill effects, the above effect will not trigger for the rest of the Encounter

When entering [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state, gain Shield equal to this unit's max HP
- Shield gained from this effect does not expire at Turn End
- When [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state expires, Shield gained from the above effect expires

- While in the [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state, aside from its exclusive Skill "As the Voice Says, I Gladly Withdraw into Myself", cannot equip Defense Skills or E.G.O Skills

Turn End: At 0 [RougeIshmaelCocoon] Stack, leave [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state and enter [RougeIshmaelEclose] state; then, gain +5 [ChargeRougeAlly] Count

- Max Stack: 2
- Fix this unit's Speed to 1
- Take -50% damage from Skills
- Immediately after gaining this effect, remove Stagger Thresholds; when Staggered, recover from Stagger

- Turn End: Lose 1 Count

statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 5
- Apply the following effect on all allied Identities:
  · On Skill Use, each ally gains Shield equal to (Preservation Potency on Don Quixote x 2)% of their respective max HP (once per turn, max 10%)

- Apply the following effects on all "Le Noir" allied Identities:
  · Offense Level +(Preservation Potency on Don Quixote / 3) (rounded down; max 2)
  · Defense Level +(Preservation Potency on Don Quixote / 2) (rounded down; max 3)

- Apply the following effects on all enemies:
  · Min & Max Speed -1 (this effect cannot reduce Min & Max Speed below 1)
  · Stagger Threshold raised by Tremor Burst +10%
  · Take +10% damage from Skills that consume Charge Count or Unique Charge (from "Le Noir" allied Identities' Skills, take +20% damage instead)

- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack

statuses.name: Tremor - Conservation
statuses.desc:
- On Tremor Burst, take Sloth Damage equal to (60 + sum of Charge Potency or Unique Charge on the attacker x 8)% of Tremor Potency, and reduce the Count by 1 (max 120%)
 · When "Le Noir" units' Skills and Passives trigger Tremor Burst, the above effect does not reduce the Count
- When hit by Tremor Burst Skills, raise Stagger Threshold by this effect's Potency
- Turn End: Lose 1 Count
(Interacts the same way as normal Tremor does to effects that raise or reduce Tremor Potency/Count)

passives.name: La Fin de l'Enfance
passives.descriptionEn: Gain Relentless Hunger based on the following conditions (50 per turn): - When this unit consumes Pulsation Count, gain Stack equal to Pulsation Count consumed - When this unit's Base Skills heal other allies' HP, gain Stack equal to actual amount healed - Gain 1 Stack for every 10 cumulative HP allies lost - On Base Attack hit by another "Le Rouge" allied Identity, gain 2 Stacks - Turn End: Gain 5 Stacks for every other "Le Rouge" allied Identity on the field Turn End: At 100+ Relentless Hunger, and if this unit does not have Noble Dignity, replace the Skill on the leftmost Skill Slot's bottom row with "La Voracité" at the next Turn Start Combat Start: If this unit equipped "La Voracité" or "La Castration" for the first time in this Encounter, gain Desperate Hunger and Noble Dignity; then, remove this unit's Stagger Threshold - Replace equipped Base Skills with Noble Dignity exclusive Skills - Base Skills that targeted allies instead activate Unopposed Attack against random enemies - At Attack End of the Skill activated by the said effect, consume all Relentless Hunger Turn End: At 150 Relentless Hunger, if this unit has Noble Dignity, and if this unit does not have "La Voracité" on its Dashboard at the next Turn Start, replace a Base Skill with "La Voracité" (prioritizes the Skill on the leftmost Slot's bottom row)
passives.descriptionKo:
다음 조건에 따라 끊임없는 허기 얻음 (턴당 최대 50)
- 자신의 맥동 횟수 소모 시 소모한 횟수만큼 얻음
- 자신의 기본 스킬로 자신을 제외한 아군의 체력 회복 시 실제 회복량만큼 얻음
- 아군의 체력 감소량 누적 10당 1 얻음
- 자신을 제외한 르루주 소속 아군 인격의 기본 공격 적중 시 2 얻음
- 턴 종료 시 자신을 제외한 르루주 소속 아군 인격 1명당 5 얻음
턴 종료 시 고귀한 품격이 없고 끊임없는 허기가 100 이상이면, 다음 턴 시작 시 가장 왼쪽 슬롯의 아래 스킬을 '라 보라시테(la voracité)'로 변경
이번 전투에서 '라 보라시테(la voracité)' 또는 '라 카스트라시옹(la castration)'을 처음 장착한 전투 시작 시, 절박한 허기와 고귀한 품격을 얻고 자신의 흐트러짐 구간 제거
- 장착했던 기본 스킬을 고귀한 품격 전용 스킬로 변경
- 아군을 지정했던 기본 스킬은 무작위 적에게 일방 공격
- 해당 효과로 발동한 스킬 공격 종료 시 끊임없는 허기 모두 소모
턴 종료 시 고귀한 품격이 있고, 끊임없는 허기가 150이면, 다음 턴 시작 시 조작 슬롯에 '라 보라시테(la voracité)'가 없을 경우, 기본 스킬 1개를 '라 보라시테(la voracité)'로 변경 (가장 왼쪽 슬롯의 아래 스킬 우선)

- 턴 종료 시 자신을 제외한 르루주 소속 아군 인격 1명당 5 얻음
턴 종료 시 고귀한 품격이 없고 끊임없는 허기가 100 이상이면, 다음 턴 시작 시 가장 왼쪽 슬롯의 아래 스킬을 '라 보라시테(la voracité)'로 변경
이번 전투에서 '라 보라시테(la voracité)' 또는 '라 카스트라시옹(la castration)'을 처음 장착한 전투 시작 시, 절박한 허기와 고귀한 품격을 얻고 자신의 흐트러짐 구간 제거
- 장착했던 기본 스킬을 고귀한 품격 전용 스킬로 변경
- 아군을 지정했던 기본 스킬은 무작위 적에게 일방 공격
- 해당 효과로 발동한 스킬 공격 종료 시 끊임없는 허기 모두 소모
턴 종료 시 고귀한 품격이 있고, 끊임없는 허기가 150이면, 다음 턴 시작 시 조작 슬롯에 '라 보라시테(la voracité)'가 없을 경우, 기본 스킬 1개를 '라 보라시테(la voracité)'로 변경 (가장 왼쪽 슬롯의 아래 스킬 우선)
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Gain Relentless Hunger based on the following conditions (50 per turn): - When this unit consumes Pulsation Count, gain Stack equal to Pulsation Count consumed - When this unit's Base Skills heal other allies' HP, gain Stack equal to actual amount healed - Gain 1 Stack for every 10 cumulative HP allies lost - On Base Attack hit by another "Le Rouge" allied Identity, gain 2 Stacks - Turn End: Gain 5 Stacks for every other "Le Rouge" allied Identity on the field Turn End: At 100+ Relentless Hunger, and if this unit does not have Noble Dignity, replace the Skill on the leftmost Skill Slot's bottom row with "La Voracité" at the next Turn Start Combat Start: If this unit equipped "La Voracité" or "La Castration" for the first time in this Encounter, gain Desperate Hunger and Noble Dignity; then, remove this unit's Stagger Threshold - Replace equipped Base Skills with Noble Dignity exclusive Skills - Base Skills that targeted allies instead activate Unopposed Attack against random enemies - At Attack End of the Skill activated by the said effect, consume all Relentless Hunger Turn End: At 150 Relentless Hunger, if this unit has Noble Dignity, and if this unit does not have "La Voracité" on its Dashboard at the next Turn Start, replace a Base Skill with "La Voracité" (prioritizes the Skill on the leftmost Slot's bottom row)

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
자신의 기본 스킬 효과로 아군의 체력 소모 시, 해당 효과로 대상이 흐트러지거나 체력이 1 미만으로 감소하지 않음
색욕 공명이 3 이상이면, 전투 종료 시 자신을 제외한 아군 (색욕 공명 / 3)명에게 다음 턴에 절박한 허기 부여 (소수점 올림)
- 르루주 소속 아군 우선. 편성 순서 순으로 부여
- 자신에게 고귀한 품격이 있으면 부여 대상 아군 수 +1 (최대 4명)
자신에게 고귀한 품격이 없으면,
- 아군에게 양극성 스킬 사용 시 행동 가능한 르루주 소속 아군 중 현재 체력이 가장 높은 1명에게 보좌 1 부여 (턴당 1회)
- 자신을 제외한 아군 충전 인격의 기본 공격 종료 시 메인 타겟이 사망하지 않았으면 해당 적에게 '주 부제드(je vous aide)' 사용 (턴당 1회)
자신에게 고귀한 품격이 있으면,
- 붉은 요람 얻음
- 현재 전투 장소에 뷔페【Buffet】 활성화
- 턴 종료 시 다음 턴에 절박한 허기 얻음
- 전투 시작 시 행동 가능한 르루주 소속 아군 중 현재 체력이 가장 높은 1명에게 보좌 부여
- 적에게 기본 공격 스킬 공격 종료 시, 메인 타겟의 라브젝트(l'abject) 수치가 5이면 '라 드망드(la demande)' 사용 (턴당 1회)
ldPassives.descriptionEn: When this unit's Base Skill effects consume an ally's HP, the ally cannot become Staggered by the said effects, and its HP does not drop below 1. Combat End: At 3+ Lust Reson., apply Desperate Hunger next turn on (Lust Reson. / 3) other allies (rounded up) - Prioritizes "Le Rouge" allies, in Deployment order - If this unit has Noble Dignity, apply this effect +1 more ally (max 4 allies) If this unit does not have Noble Dignity, - When using a Duality Skill on an ally, apply 1 Attending the Divine to the non-immobilized "Le Rouge" ally with the highest current HP (once per turn) - At Base Attack End by another allied Charge Identity, if the said Skill did not defeat its main target, use "Je vous aide" against that enemy (once per turn) If this unit has Noble Dignity, - Gain Crimson Cradle - Activate Buffet on the current battlefield - Turn End: Gain Desperate Hunger next turn - Combat Start: Apply 1 Attending the Divine to the non-immobilized "Le Rouge" ally with the highest current HP - At Attack End of a Base Attack Skill against enemies, if the main target has 5 L'Abject, use "La Demande" (once per turn)

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
출혈 발동 시 자신의 맥동 횟수 1 증가 (턴당 최대 10회)
전투 종료 시 폭주 상태가 아니고, 자신의 맥동 횟수가 15 이상이면, 맥동 횟수를 모두 소모하고 다음 턴에 폭주 3 얻음
- 15를 초과하여 (소모한 횟수 x 3) 만큼 정신력 회복 (최대 15)
폭주 소멸 시 자신의 맥동 횟수를 모두 소모하여 (소모한 횟수 x 2)만큼 체력 회복
전투 중 소모한 자신의 맥동 횟수 누적 10당 맥동 위력 1 얻음
기본 공격 스킬과 합 가능 반격 스킬이 충전 횟수를 얻는 스킬로 취급됨
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Gain 1 Pulsation Count every time Bleed is activated in this Encounter (10 times per turn) Combat End: At 15+ Pulsation Count, if this unit is not in Uncontrollable Rampage state, consume all Pulsation Count to gain 3 Uncontrollable Rampage next turn - Heal SP equal to (3 x Pulsation Count consumed beyond 15) (max 15) When Uncontrollable Rampage expires, consume all Pulsation Count on self to heal HP equal to (Pulsation Count consumed x 2) Gain 1 Pulsation Potency for every 10 cumulative Pulsation Count this unit consumes in this Encounter This unit's Base Attack Skills and Clashable Counter Skills are considered as Skills that gain Charge Count

ldPassives.nameKo: 레 푸부아르 드 라 비(les pouvoirs de la vie)
ldPassives.descriptionKo:
르루주 소속 아군이 피해로 흐트러지면, 해당 아군에게 '르 망카에트르(le manque-à-être)' 사용 (턴당 1회, 강제 흐트러짐 제외)
자신에게 고귀한 품격이 없으면,
- 르루주 소속이 아닌 아군이 피해로 흐트러지면, 해당 아군에게 '르 망카에트르(le manque-à-être)' 사용 (전투당 1회, 강제 흐트러짐 제외)
자신에게 고귀한 품격이 있으면,
- 자신을 제외한 르루주 소속 아군 인격이 체력이 0이 되는 피해를 받았을 때, 체력이 1 미만으로 감소하지 않고 최대 체력의 50%만큼 체력 회복 (소수점 올림, 인격별 전투당 1회)
ldPassives.descriptionEn: When a "Le Rouge" ally becomes Staggered due to damage, use "Le Manque-à-être" on the said ally (once per turn, excluding forced Stagger) If this unit does not have Noble Dignity, - When a non-"Le Rouge" ally becomes Staggered due to damage, use "Le Manque-à-être" on the said ally (once per Encounter, excluding forced Stagger) If this unit has Noble Dignity, - When another "Le Rouge" ally takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, HP does not drop below 1, and the said ally heals 50% HP (rounded up, once per Encounter per Identity)

ldPassives.descriptionKo:
전투 시작 시 체력이 가장 낮은 아군 1명에게 공격 레벨 증가 2 부여
해당 아군이 공격 스킬 종료 시 자신의 최대 체력의 5%만큼 체력 회복 (최소 1, 턴당 1회)
ldPassives.descriptionEn: Combat Start: Apply 2 Offense Level Up to the ally with the lowest HP The said ally heals 5% HP at Attack Skill End (min 1, once per turn)

statuses.name: Assist Defense
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- When an ally is about to take an Unopposed Attack from an enemy, consume 1 Stack to redirect the enemy's targeting to self; then, use the unique Skill that activates for Assist Defense
- When there are multiple allies that have Assist Defense Stacks, the ally that has the highest Stack has the highest activation priority
- Does not activate for allies who equipped Defense Skills
- Expires at Turn End

statuses.name: Attending the Divine
statuses.desc:
- Unique Assist Defense
- Max Stack: 1

- When Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair is about to take an Unopposed Attack from an enemy, consume 1 Stack to redirect the enemy's targeting to self
 · Then, copy and use Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair's "La Garde"
- When there are multiple allies that have Assist Defense Stacks, the ally that has the highest Stack has the highest activation priority
- This effect counts as Assist Defense, and is counted toward calculating Assist Defense Stacks

- Turn End: This effect expires

statuses.name: Buffet
statuses.desc:
- Max Value: 999
- This value is increased by (actual HP healed / 10) whenever allies' or enemies' HP is healed on the field
 · Max 100 per instance of healing
 · Rounded up for each instance
 · Healing from E.G.O Gifts does not count

- This value is shared by all characters
- Resets when moving to a different zone

statuses.name: Charge Identity
statuses.desc: Identities that have Base Attack Skills that apply, gain, or consume Charge or Unique Charge

statuses.name: Clashable Guard
statuses.desc:
- On Clash Win: raise the target's Stagger Threshold by this unit's final Clash Power.
- On Clash Lose: when hit, reduce the attacker's final Skill Power by this unit's Final Power.
- On Clash Lose: does not gain Final Power from the following sources: Resonance and the Level disparity against the Attack Skill

statuses.name: Crimson Cradle
statuses.desc:
When conditions are met by other "Le Rouge" allies, activate corresponding effects for Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair
- Effects remain active even if the corresponding ally is defeated

Le Rouge Ishmael
- If Ishmael is in "Full Makeover" state, Sinclair's max HP +10%; Sinclair heals 5% max HP On Base Attack Hit (rounded up, 5 times per turn)

statuses.name: Desperate Hunger
statuses.desc:
- Offense Level +2

- At Coin Start of a Base Attack Skill used against an enemy, consume 1 Charge Count to deal +5% damage
 · Skills that inflict Bleed Potency or Count deal +10% damage instead (including Unique Bleed)
 · At 1+ Buffet Value on the field, if this unit is not at max Charge Count, consume 1 Buffet to gain +1 Charge Count
 · If both Charge Count and Buffet are at 0, consume 1% HP on self instead to activate the effect (rounded down; damage dealt by this effect does not Stagger or reduce this unit's HP below 1; activates even at 1 HP)

- Turn End: This effect expires

statuses.name: Duality
statuses.desc:
Skills can target allied Identities
Upon auto-targeting Skills, or in Regular Encounters, prioritize the ally with the earliest Deployment Order
- If target is an ally, the attack does not hit, and does not trigger Defense Skills (including Clashable Defense Skills)
If target is an ally, activate this Skill at Combat Start

statuses.name: Hunger
statuses.desc:
Turn End: gain 1 if this unit failed to defeat an ally with Prepared Meat.
At 75%- HP, gain 2. At 50%- HP, gain 3.
Turn Start: lose 1 if this unit defeated an ally with Prepared Meat.
At 0 value, gain (# of allies defeated x 3)Attack Power Down and Defense Power Down.

statuses.name: L'Abject
statuses.desc:
- Unique Bleed
- Max Stack: 5
- Take +2% damage from "Le Rouge" Identities for every Stack (max 10%)
- Turn Start: Gain +1 Bleed Count
- Turn End: Gain (Stack / 2) Bind next turn (rounded down)
- Turn Start: If Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair is not on the field, this effect expires

statuses.name: Noble Dignity
statuses.desc:
Gain all of the following effects based on Pulsation Potency on self:
- 2+: Take -25% damage from Bleed
- 3+: Base Skills inflict +1 more Bleed Potency and Count
- 4+: Base Skill Base Power +1

- Min & Max Speed +1
- When this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, this unit's HP does not drop below 1 for the turn (once per Encounter)

- Apply the following effects to "Le Rouge" allied Identities (including this unit):
  · Min & Max Speed +1
  · If there is not enough Charge Count to activate the effects of Skills that consume Charge Count, consume 1 Buffet to gain 1 Charge Count for every missing Charge Count required for activation

statuses.name: Power Up
statuses.desc: Skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Pulsation
statuses.desc:
- Unique Charge
- Max Count: 20
- Interacts the same way as normal Charge does to effects that raise or reduce Charge Potency and Count
- Turn End: Lose 1 Count

statuses.name: Rampage
statuses.desc: - If the 'You do not know the fathoms of the eye's powers, its special nature' Skill's main target is Hong Lu, ignore all Skill effects and convert all Coins on that Skill to Unbreakable Coins

statuses.name: Relentless Hunger
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 150
- Can gain up to 50 Stacks per turn

statuses.name: Uncontrollable Rampage
statuses.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- Offense Level +1 for every Stack (max 3)
- Min & Max Speed +1
- Deal +1% damage for every Bleed on self (max 15%)

- Cannot become Staggered (excluding forced Stagger)
- Take -50% damage from Bleed
- Cannot be defeated by Bleed damage

- On Base Attack Skill Use, gain +3 Bleed Count
- On Base Attack Skill Hit, gain Bleed equal to Uncontrollable Rampage Stack

- Turn End: Lose 1 Count

statuses.name: Attack Power Up
statuses.desc: Attack skills gain final Power by the effect’s Count for one turn.

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc: When attacking, take fixed damage equal to (Count)% of current HP, then halve it.

statuses.name: Charge
statuses.desc: Resource used by certain skills for additional effects. Its Count can go up to 20. Count lowers by 1 at the end of each turn.

statuses.name: Clash Power Up
statuses.desc: In a Clash, gain Clash Power equal to the value

statuses.name: Lust Fragility
statuses.desc: Take more damage from Lust skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)

statuses.name: Offense Level Up
statuses.desc: Offense level increases based on the effect's Potency for one turn.

statuses.name: Unbreakable Coin
statuses.desc:
- This coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1
